title: Deal Desk Manager, APAC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4><strong>About the Deal Desk Team</strong></h4> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.</p> <p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health. Build creative financial models and custom discount strategies that align customer usage patterns with corporate revenue goals.</li> <li>Sales Co-pilot & Strategic Influence: Serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership, utilizing data driven insights and workflows to maximize deal velocity, improve LTV, and ensure discovery reflects true customer needs. Perform analysis on pricing and deal terms, leveraging AI insights to recommend "next best action" for deal structuring and margin optimization. Drive consensus across internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Revenue Recognition, Compliance and Product) to negotiate viable compromises on non-standard commercial, financial, and legal terms while safeguarding corporate margin thresholds and risk tolerance.</li> <li>Champion AI, Curate and Tune AI Agents for Automation Integration: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale. Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.</li> <li>Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Specifications & Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience with a proven track record supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of direct deal desk experience (deal analysis, deal governance and customer negotiation) preferred</li> <li><strong>Financial & Sales Acumen: </strong>Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus</li> <li><strong>Contract & Pricing Knowledge: </strong>Experience drafting and interpreting commercial contracts, with a focus on terms that impact revenue recognition and financial risk. Ability to analyze and recommend the best course of action for complex pricing and licensing situations</li> <li><strong>Data & AI Literacy: </strong>Proficiency in leveraging agentic workflows and prompt engineering to scale influence, extract insights from large datasets, and automate repetitive operational tasks and internal documentation. Ability to understand and audit automated pricing models to ensure alignment with long-term company goals.Relentless focus on iterative automation and translating complex business policies into streamlined, automated logic</li> <li><strong>Strategic Influence & Negotiation: </strong>Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, internal cross-functional negotiations and make high-judgment decisions in fast-paced environments. Partner directly with Sales Management and Account Executives  during external customer negotiations, equipping them with counter-proposal options or directly engaging in client commercial discussions to structure win-win enterprise agreements</li> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>Serve as the single point of contact between Sales, Finance, Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), Legal, and Product Management on advising deal constructing and managing deal escalation. Skilled in commercial negotiation strategy, advising Sales on customer-facing concessions, and directly engaging in external negotiations with customer procurement/legal teams to drive deal closure. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, capable of explaining complex deal structures and financial data to both technical and executive stakeholders</li> <li>Language Preference: Additional proficiency in Mandarin or Japanese would be beneficial for engaging with customers and stakeholders in relevant APJC markets.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Werkstudent:in IT-Support
description: Unsere Mission Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, unseren Planeten zu retten – ein Second Hand Produkt nach dem anderen. Der Laptop startet nicht, der Drucker streikt, und der neue Kollege braucht bis Montag seine Zugänge? Du sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Als Werkstudent:in im IT Operations Team bist du 20 Stunden pro Woche bei uns im Berliner Office am Ostkreuz und damit direkt vor Ort, wenn es brennt. Du hältst unsere momoxians sowohl im Büro als auch remote arbeitsfähig und sammelst praktische Erfahrung im gesamten Bereich IT-Support. Die Stelle startet zum 01.12. und wird mit einem Stundenlohn von 16,00 € vergütet. Das wirst du meistern Du unterstützt alle Mitarbeitenden bei technischen Fragen, egal ob sie im Büro oder remote arbeiten Du analysierst Software- und Hardwareprobleme mit Laptops, Druckern und Mobilgeräten und löst sie Du bearbeitest Incidents in unserem Ticketsystem (Jira Service Management) Du legst Benutzerkonten an und verwaltest Zugriffe auf unsere IT-Systeme Du unterstützt beim Einkauf von Hardware, Software, Zubehör und Verbrauchsmaterial Du pflegst unser internes Asset-Management-System Das bringst du mit Du bist in einem IT-nahen Studiengang eingeschrieben Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen an allen momox Standorten Du lernst gerne Neues und arbeitest dich schnell ein Du löst Probleme eigenständig und bleibst auch bei kniffligen Fällen lösungsorientiert Du kommunizierst klar, auch mit Kolleg:innen ohne technischen Hintergrund Nice to have: Praktische Erfahrung mit Windows, macOS und Linux Erfahrung mit Android- und iOS-Geräten Kenntnisse in Google Workspace und gängigen Office-Tools Darauf kannst du dich freuen Offenes Arbeitsumfeld : Wir arbeiten gemeinsam in einem hellen, offenen Großraumbüro, in dem die wenigen vorhandenen Türen immer offen stehen. Unsere Teams sind motiviert und aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen. Bringe deine Kreativität ein und setze sie um! Wenn du einen Moment der Ruhe brauchst, kannst du dich in eine gemütliche Ecke der medimops-Bibliothek im Pausenraum zurückziehen oder dich bei einer Runde Kicker, Tischtennis oder an der PlayStation austoben. Unternehmensrabatte : Als momoxian kannst du dich jeden Monat auf einen Gutschein für unseren momox Fashion Onlineshop, sowie medimops freuen. Darüber hinaus profitierst du natürlich von zahlreichen Unternehmensrabatten unserer Partner. Nachhaltigkeit : Wir lieben Second Hand und integrieren unsere nachhaltige Geschäftsidee mit einfachen Methoden in den Büroalltag durch nachhaltiges Verbrauchsmaterial, doppelseitigen Druck, Energiesparmodus an Geräten, Mülltrennung, etc. Dabei übernehmen wir Verantwortung und integrieren Nachhaltigkeit in all unsere Tätigkeiten. Firmenfeiern : Der Spaß an unserer Arbeit und das gemeinsame Feiern unserer Erfolge sind fest in unseren Werten verankert. Deshalb treffen wir uns regelmäßig zu verschiedenen Events, um uns auszutauschen, besser kennenzulernen und unseren Teamgeist weiter zu stärken. Bürohunde : Unsere Bürohunde tragen zu einer entspannten Arbeitsatmosphäre bei und freuen sich immer über eine extra Portion Streicheleinheiten. 1/2 Tag Urlaub am Geburtstag : An deinem Geburtstag bekommst du einen halben Tag Urlaub. Komm später, geh früher oder nimm einfach noch einen halben Tag Urlaub dazu, um deinen ganzen Geburtstag frei zu haben – vorausgesetzt, dein Geburtstag fällt auf einen regulären Arbeitstag. Außerdem bekommst du am 24.12. und 31.12. je einen halben Tag frei. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Cyber Security Engineer - Infrastructure & AI Platform Security (w/m/d)
description: Über IONOS Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns. Beide Hälften dieser Rolle drehen sich um dieselbe grundlegende Frage: Welche Systeme können unsere empfindlichste Infrastruktur erreichen und unter welchen Kontrollen. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur unserer providerseitigen Infrastrukturschicht und bist Fachexperte (m/w/d) für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen und -Agenten. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass diese in einem sicheren, verwalteten und auditierbaren Zustand laufen, anstatt sich schleichend als neue Klasse von privilegierten Zugriffen anzuhäufen. Dies ist eine praxisnahe Expertenrolle. Du setzt Standards, prüfst Designs auf Herz und Nieren und arbeitest direkt mit Plattform- und Engineering-Teams über all unsere Marken hinweg zusammen, um diese umzusetzen. Aufgabenbereich Infrastruktursicherheit Definieren und Pflegen von Sicherheitsarchitektur-Standards und Härtungs-Baselines für providerseitige Infrastruktur: Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Control Planes und Bereitstellungssysteme, DNS, Mail-Infrastruktur sowie Backup- und Wiederherstellungssysteme. Bewerten und Stärken der Mandantenisolierung über Shared-Hosting-, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Schichten hinweg sowie Treiben von Behebungsmaßnahmen mit den verantwortlichen Plattform-Teams. Überprüfen von Infrastruktur-Designs und wesentlichen Änderungen auf Sicherheitsauswirkungen sowie Agieren als Eskalationsinstanz für Fragen zur Infrastruktursicherheit aus Plattform-, Cloud- und Marken-Engineering-Teams. Reduzieren des Blast Radius auf den wichtigsten Pfaden: privilegierter Zugriff auf kundenorientierte Infrastruktur, administrative Segmentierung, Umgang mit Secrets und Wiederherstellungsintegrität — übersetzt in umsetzbare markenspezifische Implementierungspläne für unsere heterogenen Plattformen. Unterstützen von Cyber Defense, Vulnerability Management und IT-Notfallmanagement mit Infrastruktur-Expertise bei Vorfällen und der Nachbereitung/Härtung. Interne KI-Plattform- und Agentensicherheit Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur und Baseline-Standards für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen: Modell-Gateways und self-hosted Modelle, Agenten-Frameworks, Assistenten-Integrationen, Konnektoren und Retrieval-Pipelines über interne Daten. Definieren und Durchsetzen, wie Agenten identifiziert, authentifiziert und autorisiert werden: Umgang mit nicht-menschlichen Identitäten, Credential- und Token-Management, Least-Privilege-Zugriff auf Tools und Systeme sowie Festlegung, wo autonomes Handeln ein Human-in-the-Loop erfordert. Festlegen, welche Daten interne KI-Systeme aufrufen und indexieren dürfen, sowie Sicherstellen, dass Agentenaktivitäten protokolliert, zuordenbar und überprüfbar sind — entsprechend den Anforderungen unserer regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Zertifizierungen. Durchführen von Pre-Deployment-Sicherheitsprüfungen für neue interne KI-Plattformen und Agenten-Anwendungsfälle im Einklang mit dem schnellen Tempo der Adaption sowie Überblicken von ungesicherter/unsanktionierter KI-Nutzung (Shadow AI). Beraten der Sicherheitsfunktionen und internen Engineering-Teams bei der sicheren Einführung von KI, einschließlich der Schutzplanken (Guardrails), die eine vertretbare Einführung ermöglichen. Qualifikationen Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Infrastruktur- oder Plattform-Sicherheit, idealerweise bei einem Hosting-Anbieter, Cloud-Anbieter, Telekommunikationsunternehmen oder in einer vergleichbar großen Mandantenumgebung. Tiefes praktisches Wissen über Linux, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Netzwerke und die Sicherheitseigenschaften von Mandanten-Infrastrukturen. Starker Hintergrund im Bereich Identity & Access: Privileged Access, Maschinen- und Workload-Identitäten, Secrets Management, Autorisierungsmodelle und Infrastructure-as-Code-Sicherheit. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Durchsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards in einer heterogenen, teils historisch gewachsenen Landschaft sowie bei der Akzeptanzgewinnung in Teams außerhalb der eigenen Führungslinie. Praktische Kenntnisse im Aufbau und Betrieb von LLM- und Agenten-Systemen sowie der spezifischen Risiken: Prompt Injection durch unvertraute Daten, zu weit gefasste Tool-Zugriffe, Datenexposition durch Retrieval, unprotokolliertes autonomes Handeln, Modell- und Anbieterabhängigkeiten. Fähigkeit, risikobasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und zu verteidigen — einschließlich des Blockierens von Deployments mit klarer Begründung — sowie technisches Risiko gegenüber nicht-technischen Stakeholdern verständlich zu erklären. Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind aufgrund unseres regulatorischen Umfelds und des öffentlichen Sektors von starkem Vorteil. Wünschenswert / Von Vorteil Praktische Erfahrung beim Deployment oder der Absicherung interner KI-Plattformen, Agenten-Frameworks oder Tool-Calling-Integrationen in einer Produktionsumgebung. Vertrautheit mit NIS2 / BSIG oder ISO 27001. Hintergrund in DNS, E-Mail-Infrastruktur oder plattformnaher Missbrauchsbekämpfung (Abuse). Erfahrung in einem Multimarken- oder Post-Acquisition-Umfeld, in dem dieselbe Control in verschiedenen Implementierungen umgesetzt werden muss. Hintergrund in Security Engineering oder Softwareentwicklung (Automatisierung, Tooling, Scripting). Wer zu uns passt Jemand, der sich wohl damit fühlt, bei bestimmten Fragestellungen die/der einzige Expert*in im Raum zu sein, der lieber Ursachen behebt als nur Befunde zu dokumentieren, und der über Sicherheitsfunktionen und Plattform-Teams hinweg agieren kann. Du solltest echtes Interesse an KI-Systemen als Engineering-Artefakte mitbringen, nicht nur als Richtlinienthema — ein Großteil dieser Praxis entsteht gerade erst, und Du wirst unsere mitgestalten. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell. Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit. An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke. Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte. Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops. Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse. Hinweis zur Bewerbung Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht. title: Kaufmännische Assistenz der Geschäftsleitung mit Schwerpunkt Projektmanagement und Finanzen
description: Deine Aufgaben Operativer Tagesgeschäft Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende, Geschäftspartnerinnen, externe Ansprechpartnerinnen und Dienstleister. Du organisierst und pflegst den Kalender des CEO, koordinierst Termine und sorgst für eine effiziente Tages- und Wochenplanung. Du planst nationale und internationale Geschäftsreisen und koordinierst alle organisatorischen Details für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Du bereitest Termine des CEO inhaltlich und organisatorisch vor, erstellst Unterlagen und Briefings, dokumentierst Ergebnisse und verfolgst vereinbarte Aufgaben nach. Du bearbeitest Schriftverkehr sowie eingehende Post, E-Mails und Telefonanfragen und stellst eine professionelle Kommunikation sicher. Finanzen und Administration Du führst die vorbereitende Buchhaltung durch, sammelst und prüfst Belege und Unterlagen und unterstützt bei der Abwicklung und Überwachung des Zahlungsverkehrs. title: Senior Software Engineer - Product Builder
description: Chez Seyna, notre mission est simple: permettre aux professionnels de l'assurance de protéger ceux qui voient grand. Rejoins notre mission ! 🚀 Seyna est un assureur qui apporte une efficacité incomparable aux courtiers. Grâce à sa technologie et à la réactivité de ses équipes, Seyna accompagne les courtiers à chaque étape de leur développement : création du produit d'assurance sur-mesure, outils de vente et de gestion, analyse et amélioration du produit d'assurance, conformité. Depuis son lancement en 2019, date à laquelle Seyna a obtenu son agrément ACPR d'assureur, Seyna a convaincu plus de 100 courtiers, dont SPVIE, Verspieren, WTW, Garantme, APRIL, Marsh ou encore Dalma. Ils utilisent Seyna pour protéger près de deux millions d'assurés dans 6 pays européens. Grâce à un investissement de 57 millions d'euros de la part de GFC, WhiteStar Capital, Elaia et 115K (La Banque Postale) Seyna a des ambitions mondiales pour améliorer le secteur de l'assurance en modernisant la conception et la gestion des programmes d'assurance. TA FUTURE ÉQUIPE : L'équipe Product & Engineering, c'est le cerveau technologique de Seyna : elle construit la plateforme qui fait tourner Seyna et ses courtiers, du travail de discovery jusqu'à la mise en production, en sprints de 2 semaines. En tant que Software Product Engineer, tu rejoins l'équipe Tech avec un rôle unique, embarqué au plus près des équipes métier (actuariat, juridique, comptabilité…), en reportant directement à Guillaume, notre CPTO. Ta mission : construire avec l'IA les outils qui vont démultiplier la productivité de toute l'entreprise ! CE QUE TU FERAS : Immersion métier : Plonger dans l'équipe que tu outilles et pratiquer réellement son métier, pour comprendre de l'intérieur ses processus, ses contraintes réglementaires et ses irritants du quotidien. Discovery & priorisation : Mener la recherche utilisateur (interviews, observation, analyse des process), identifier les problèmes à plus fort impact et piloter seul ton backlog selon la valeur business attendue. Specs & architecture : Traduire les besoins en specs concises et en décisions d'architecture documentées, pour que chaque choix soit tracé et facilement repris par l'équipe Tech. Delivery de bout en bout : Développer, tester et mettre en production toi-même tes solutions, avec un vrai niveau de qualité production (code review, tests, monitoring, documentation). Livrer vite, sans créer de dette ! L'IA au cœur du build : Utiliser les agents de code (Claude Code…) comme levier de vélocité, et intégrer l'IA directement dans les outils que tu construis : automatisation, extraction, génération, agents métier. Mesure & itération : Définir des critères de succès avec le métier, mesurer l'adoption et l'impact de tes outils, et itérer rapidement à partir des données et des retours utilisateurs. Alignement & diffusion : Réutiliser les briques existantes de la plateforme Seyna avec les équipes Product & Engineering, faire remonter ce qui mérite d'être industrialisé et partager tes méthodes de build augmenté par l'IA pour faire monter toute l'organisation en niveau. TU ES AU BON ENDROIT SI : Tu maîtrises le développement full-stack en TypeScript (React, Node.js) sur AWS et GitHub, et tu livres du code de qualité production. Tu as une vraie rigueur d'ingénierie : architecture réfléchie, tests, code review, monitoring et documentation font partie de ton ADN. Tu es AI-native : les agents de code font partie de ton quotidien, et tu sais intégrer l'IA dans des produits utiles. Tu sais mener une discovery : interviewer, observer, et formuler clairement le vrai problème avant d'écrire la moindre ligne de code. Tu apprends vite et tu adores plonger dans un métier qui n'est pas le tien. Tu es orienté(e) impact : tu mesures ce que tu livres et tu t'appuies sur la data pour décider de la suite. Tu aimes résoudre des problèmes complexes et tu sais embarquer des profils tech comme non-tech, sans autorité hiérarchique. ✨ Bonus si tu as déjà rédigé des specs et arbitré un backlog dans un rôle de Product Manager. CE QUE SEYNA TE PROPOSE : 💵 Rémunération : Un package compétitif avec des BSPCE pour que vous puissiez partager le succès à mesure que nous grandissons. 🏖 Congés payés : 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de vos 28 jours de congés payés. 🍜 Ticket restaurant : Une carte ticket restaurant Benefiz prise en charge à 60% par Seyna (10€/jour). 🚇 Transport en commun : 50% de votre moyen de transport préféré (Navigo, vélo, train) pris en charge par Seyna. 🚑 Assurance santé : Mutuelle Generali prise en charge à 95% par Seyna 🏄 Événements d'équipe : Un séminaire annuel pour profiter de moments tous ensemble. 🧡 Une équipe positive avec qui travailler au quotidien et une opportunité excitante de rejoindre une insurtech à forte ambition (FT120) ! NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT : En moyenne, notre processus de recrutement dure 2 à 3 semaines ! Voici plus de détail ci-dessous : Un 1er échange avec Gianni (Talent Acquisition Manager) - 45' → Tu pourras mieux comprendre le rôle, les missions et ce qu'on attend pour ce poste. Un Hiring Manager Interview avec Guillaume (CPTO) - 45' → Cela te permettra d'entrer dans le détail du poste : les missions au quotidien, les défis et les attentes liées au rôle. Un Skills-based Assessment avec Kseniia (Engineering Manager) et Maxime (Senior Staff Engineer) - 60' → Le case te donne l'occasion de montrer concrètement tes compétences et ton savoir-faire en lien avec le job. Un Seynalma Interview avec Charlotte (Client Performance Director) et Anne-Céline (Senior CSM) - 2x45' → Cela te permettra de voir si notre culture d'entreprise colle avec tes valeurs et ta façon de travailler. Un Final Interview avec Stephen (CEO) - 30' → C'est le moment d'échanger avec notre CEO et de voir si tes drivers matchent avec nos 3 Unique Selling Propositions pour les Talents ! title: Sales Development Representative - CDI
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Notre mission Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation. ⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation . Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 ! 💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! Le mot de la CEO “Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs. Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon Et ce poste alors ? Le rôle En première ligne de notre développement commercial , tu travailleras main dans la main avec le Sales Manager et les Account Executives au sein d'une équipe outillée et ambitieuse, sur un cycle de vente court. Missions et responsabilités Prospection intensive et ciblée (Outbound) : Identifier et qualifier des comptes clés dans le secteur de l'installation solaire. Tu contacteras les prospects via une approche multicanale avec une majorité de Cold Calling (notre cible d'artisans est très réceptive au téléphone), du Cold Emailing et LinkedIn. Qualification des leads (Inbound & Outbound) : Traiter rapidement les demandes entrantes générées par le marketing. Tu devras qualifier les besoins lors des premiers appels de découverte et transformer l'intérêt en rendez-vous de démonstration qualifié pour l'équipe de closing. Rigueur opérationnelle et Data : Assurer une tenue irréprochable de notre CRM (HubSpot) via la mise à jour des statuts, la prise de notes et le log des appels. Tu utiliseras notre stack et suivras tes KPIs quotidiens et hebdomadaires. Amélioration continue : Remonter les objections fréquentes et les retours du terrain au VP Sales et au Marketing pour affiner le discours. Tu participeras activement aux sessions de coaching et de partage de bonnes pratiques de l'équipe. Tes objectifs: ⭐ 0 à 1 mois : L'onboarding et les premiers pas Acquérir une compréhension parfaite du produit Solteo, de la proposition de valeur et du marché cible. Prendre en main la stack technique (HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo) et lancer tes premières séquences de prospection et appels à froid pour générer tes premiers SQL. 🎯 Objectif : Maîtrise du pitch commercial, des outils de prospection et autonomie dans la génération de rendez-vous. ⭐ 1 à 8 mois : L'exécution et la machine à leads Exécuter les séquences avec régularité et intensité. Atteindre et dépasser tes quotas de rendez-vous bookés. Devenir une machine de qualification tout en encaissant les refus sans perdre ta motivation. 🎯 Objectif : Alimenter continuellement les agendas des Account Executives avec des leads ultra-qualifiés. ⭐ À partir de 8 mois : Les premières démos (Closing) C'est la concrétisation de ta montée en compétences ! title: Applied Research Engineer, Evaluation
description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX — foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and videos. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why This Role Frontier image and video models are now good enough that the hard question is no longer whether they work, but whether a new one is actually better, and how you'd know. Aesthetics, prompt following, editing fidelity, text rendering, character consistency: none of these collapse into a single number, and public benchmarks have fallen well behind the models they're meant to measure. You'll work on the system BFL uses to answer that question. Every FLUX checkpoint, every finetuning and RL run, and every competitor release goes through our evaluation stack, and you'll help build and sharpen it. Product Research relies on what it shows to decide what to fix next, and to confirm the fix worked. It gets harder from here. FLUX 3 is our first multimodal model, spanning image, video, audio and action, and each new modality needs its own way of being measured. What You'll Work On What you focus on will depend on where you're strongest and what the team needs most when you join. In scope: Building and maintaining the evaluation stack that every model checkpoint has to pass through and prove itself on, from automated benchmarking and LLM-as-judge pipelines, to human evaluation through panels (Prolific and otherwise). Designing the breadth of evaluation across the taxonomy, from prompt adherence, editing fidelity, aesthetics, text rendering, subject and character consistency, to safety. Evaluating the evaluation stack itself: checking that human and automated evals agree, that results stay stable over time, and improving them when they don't. Benchmarking FLUX against the frontier models continuously, while obtaining a meaningful perspective on where we are better or worse than competitors and what such differences really mean. Finding the ways in which the quality of the model's output falls short that are not captured by aggregate numbers. Closing the loop, ideally, with the RL and finetuning researchers, by defining target metrics for them to aim for, and verifying that a new checkpoint improved the weakness without introducing new ones. Designing how best to exploit the signals we already capture through the API and MCP, and what new signals we should capture, with help from research, data engineering and legal. Maintaining the usefulness of existing metrics as their natural lifecycle brings up concerns of gaming and overfitting, and anticipating this for new metrics. What We're Looking For You have made meaningful contributions to the evaluation of generative models already. You understand that a benchmark figure without careful consideration of sample size and judge agreement with humans is at best uninformed optimism and at worst dangerously misleading, and you have been the person that found that inconvenient regression that nobody wanted to talk about. You likely have: Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a relevant field or demonstrated equivalent practical experience Practical experience with evaluating generative models, in a hands-on way. You may have worked with diffusion or flow-matching based image or video models already, but the capability to evaluate them in earnest transfers to other modalities too Very strong Python and software engineering skills, with pipelines that run reliably and that other people can read if needed Working knowledge of PyTorch and modern ML infrastructure and practices; you are not a pure Python developer, you know what the modern ML code looks like Strong grasp of statistics and its shortcomings in practice, and how to work with those; sample sizes, inter-annotator agreement, confidence levels, etc., and a healthy skepticism about what those numbers say about the world Practical experience with building and operating LLM-as-judge systems, and understanding their limitations Working knowledge of modern benchmarking practices and of standard datasets and benchmarks in the field already; you have an idea of which to trust and which to disregard The inclination to look at the actual outputs your system is judging, and to care about what is there beyond an aggregate score We'd be especially excited if you: Have practical experience with human evaluation, including study design and execution via panels, and analysis of disagreements and annotator performance Have worked where evaluation meets training (reward models, preference data, RLHF, DPO or similar) and know that whatever you optimize for is what the model learns Have evaluated agentic or multi-step systems and know how hard it is to attribute success or failure to a single step Have built tools that people actually want to use internally Have made public contributions to the field: papers, open source, or otherwise How We Work Together We're a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in Freiburg, where you'll join us at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We'll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we've structured things to make it accessible to all. We'll discuss what this will look like during our interview process. Everything we do is grounded in four values: Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task. Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos. If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you. A profitable, growing business. No funding round decides whether your team still exists next year. The FAQ below is in German, as is our working day. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. title: Legal AI Engineer (Berlin or Leipzig)
description: Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale. We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does. Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against. 2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job. If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold. 1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus. 2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer. 3. title: Staff Software Engineer, Privacy Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord is on a mission to create space for everyone to find belonging. Trusted by millions of people to keep their communications private and out of the hands of evildoers, Security and Privacy are necessary to Discord's success.</p> <p>We're looking for a Staff Privacy Engineer to join us in Amsterdam and shape how we build privacy into our products and operations. If you pair deep privacy technology and compliance fluency with a builder's instinct for automation and system design, read on!</p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and deliver the roadmap for the Privacy Engineering Amsterdam team: define priorities, scope multi-quarter initiatives, and drive them to completion across engineering, product, and legal stakeholders.Drive collaboration and advisement with engineering teams across Lisbon and Amsterdam, acting as the senior privacy voice in architecture reviews, product design, and incident response for our European engineering hubs.</li> <li>Partner with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product, Data, and Legal to conduct privacy impact assessments, code and architecture reviews, and ensure compliance with Discord's Privacy Principles and regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Develop actionable data privacy policies and drive the creation and monitoring of controls that ensure adherence, grounding Discord's privacy posture in industry frameworks.</li> <li>Design privacy-preserving product solutions, act as the privacy subject matter expert for the region, and identify new opportunities to advance our privacy posture.</li> <li>Lead privacy impact analysis on production incidents, direct technical validation of remediations and external responses, and raise the bar for how the team operates.</li> <li>Shape and scale our central privacy systems: from evidencing automation to data subject rights fulfillment, you will use your technical skills, privacy expertise, and AI tooling chops to multiply the team's impact — and mentor other engineers to do the same.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A passion for user privacy and data protection.</li> <li>7+ years of experience in technical privacy, data protection, or adjacent engineering roles, including experience leading significant privacy initiatives end-to-end. Example projects could include implementing Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PETs), data classification and discovery, and developing data subject rights systems.</li> <li>A track record of owning and delivering a technical roadmap: translating regulatory and business requirements into a prioritized plan, and landing it across multiple teams.</li> <li>Deep operational and technical fluency with GDPR, and strong command of the broader privacy compliance landscape (CPRA/CPPA, EU AI Act, etc).</li> <li>Experience automating privacy compliance at scale, such as the development of DPIAs, maintaining data maps and records of processing (RoPA), and assessing vendor/processor risk.</li> <li>Ability to automate evidence collection and program workflows (e.g. Python and AI tooling), and the architecture fluency to evaluate privacy risks and design mitigations in complex distributed systems.</li> <li>Outstanding written communication and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, and Legal — including driving alignment across offices and time zones. Occasional virtual meetings with employees in US timezones may be necessary.</li> <li>Fluent English required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading privacy incident response and regulator engagement.</li> <li>Experience mentoring or leading privacy or security engineers.</li> <li>Familiarity with privacy tooling (e.g. OneTrust, BigID, TrustArc).</li> <li>Exposure to AI governance and the EU AI Act.</li> <li>Experience working across EU and US time zones.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and monitoring a privacy or security control framework (e.g. ISO 27701, ISO 27001, or NIST Privacy Framework).</li> </ul> <p><em>The base salary range for this full-time position is €128,000</em><em> to €160,000</em><em> + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in NL role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.<br><br>Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Amsterdam, NL Area and attend the office 1-2 days a week.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Discord? </strong><br><br>Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. <strong>Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!</strong></p> <p><strong>Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. </strong>We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.</p> <p><em><strong>Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking <a href="https://discord.com/terms/applicant-candidate-privacy-policy">HERE.</a></strong></em></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: YouTube Producer & Editor: Generative AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Creative Fabrica</strong></p> <p>Creative Fabrica is a fast-growing AI platform that makes it easy for everyday consumers to create whatever they imagine, from images and videos to audio and 3D creations, using the latest generative AI models.</p></div><p>We want to make it even easier for users to bring their ideas to life by providing tutorials, instructions and engaging educational episodes on our YouTube channel. That’s where you come in!</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p><strong>This is a full-time, in-office role at our Amsterdam HQ, with 30 work-from-anywhere days per year.</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for someone who loves long-form video editing and lives and breathes YouTube. You obsess over video structure, hooks and pacing, and understand what makes a title or thumbnail worth clicking. You follow editors like Hayden Hillier-Smith, Finzar and Jordan Orme, and can explain the creative decisions that make a video work.</p> <p>You’ll work alongside our YouTube Creator & Host and a dedicated motion designer to turn creative AI workflows into videos people love watching. title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (LLM Inference Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.<br>The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.<br>Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.<br><br><strong>Global team, diverse perspectives</strong></p> <p>We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.<br><br><strong>Unicorn momentum</strong></p> <p>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization.</p> <p>Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&L.<br>This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap.</p> <p><strong>The problem: </strong>running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply.</p> <p><strong>Stack</strong></p> <p>Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tempo.</p> <h4>Requirements:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years building real ML systems, with a portfolio that shows depth in inference or training infrastructure (not just model training notebooks).</li> <li>Strong Python - production services, not scripts.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with at least one of vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, and a working mental model of why an inference engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>Fluency with quantization tradeoffs - you've measured quality regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Comfort with distributed systems: collective communication, sharding strategies, and the practical failure modes of multi-GPU and multi-node setups.</li> <li>A bias toward measurement. You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell the difference between a real win and a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>Self-direction. This role comes with a wide mandate; you should be excited by that, not unsettled by it.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities:</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, speculative decoding, chunked prefill, kernel-level tuning across vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and TPOT separately. Profile, identify the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, networking), and fix it - not the bottleneck you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Paged attention, prefix caching, eviction policies, cache reuse across requests, quantized KV. This is where a lot of the unrealized throughput lives, and it's an area you'll own.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8, INT4, FP8 across weights, activations, and KV. Empirical work: measure quality on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Shrink cold starts and memory footprint. Faster init, smarter weight loading, tighter memory accounting - the difference between a model that scales and one that doesn't.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. </li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI </em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: AI Harness Engineer - Agentic & Autonomous Operations (m/f/x)
description: xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators. We take responsibility for guest communication, team coordination and issue resolution, so customers can hand over the work without handing over their business. Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through. Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done. We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it. Tasks We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems. You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response. What You’ll Own Agent harness architecture: Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs. Decision and execution behavior: Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text. Context and memory: Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost. Tools and real-world effects: Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred. Evaluation and regression testing: Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns. Observability and failure analysis: Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software. Continuous improvement: Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture. Production ownership: Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution. Requirements What Makes You a Great Fit You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python. You have built a substantial LLM-powered, automation, workflow, or decision system: not only notebooks, chat interfaces, prompt experiments, or a basic retrieval pipeline. You understand the engineering layer around a model: orchestration, state, context, tools, structured outputs, permissions, retries, fallbacks, observability, and evaluations. You can connect intelligence to real work: selecting relevant evidence, making a bounded decision, invoking tools or APIs, and verifying that the intended result occurred. You design for partial failure and uncertainty. You think deliberately about when an agent should act, retry, wait, stop, ask for help, or escalate. You evaluate behavior systematically. You use representative cases, traces, outcome checks, comparisons, and regression tests rather than treating a plausible response as proof of success. You have shipped software that people or operational processes depend on and have worked through debugging, timeouts, inconsistent data, changing APIs, and production incidents. You can investigate ambiguous problems independently, define a useful system boundary, explain trade-offs clearly, and turn decisions into working software. You care about simplicity and control. You know when a deterministic workflow is better than an agent and when additional autonomy is justified by evidence. You bring useful expertise and an independent perspective. Strong adjacent experience in workflow engines, developer tooling, distributed systems, automation platforms, or integration-heavy backend software can be highly relevant when paired with credible LLM-system understanding. Around 2+ years of professional software-engineering experience is a useful guide, not a hard requirement. What matters is the technical depth of what you built, the decisions and production outcomes you owned, and your ability to learn unfamiliar systems. You May Not Be a Great Fit If Your LLM experience is mainly prompt engineering, chatbots, basic RAG, or connecting a model API to a user interface. Your background is primarily offline data analysis, model training, or experimentation, and you do not want to own production software and operational behavior. You treat retrieval as the complete agent architecture rather than one possible source of context within a larger execution system. You consider a coherent model response successful without verifying the decision, tool call, state change, or real-world outcome. You rely on an agent framework to provide the system design and are not comfortable reasoning about the control flow, state, permissions, and failure behavior underneath it. You are not interested in owning evaluations, trace analysis, regression testing, and production learning alongside feature development. You prefer fully scoped implementation tasks with stable requirements and limited responsibility for product or operational outcomes. Benefits Real ownership: you're not maintaining someone else's codebase, you're building a core, novel part of the product from the ground up. Build at the core. Own a defining part of xHeron’s technology, from the first architectural decisions to production. Shape the direction. Work directly with our CTO, challenge assumptions and help decide what we build, not just how. Grow beyond the job description. We invest in your development, with room to expand your ownership and take on technical leadership as xHeron grows. Share in the upside. Salary plus VSOP participation, so you can benefit from the value you help create. Our Process Intro call (15-30 min): a conversation with Friedrich (CTO) about your background, what you've built, and why this role. Technical take-home case study: a short, real engineering problem, close to what you'd actually be building. Case study interview (1 hour): you walk us through your thinking, not just the final code. Culture fit (30 min): meet both Founders and make sure it's a fit both ways. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Founder's Associate (Praktikum)
description: TL;DR — alago bringt KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement in die Baubranche. Als Founder's Associate (Praktikum) arbeitest du direkt mit den Foundern, hältst den operativen Maschinenraum am Laufen — Hiring, Ops, Datenschutz, Produkt- und AI-Setup — und übernimmst daneben eigene Projekte, die unser Wachstum beschleunigen. Vollzeit-Praktikum, vor Ort in München, Start Oktober 2026. Intro Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder , weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind. Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche . Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden . Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern. Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen. 75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Tasks In dieser Rolle baust du die Maschine, während wir sie skalieren . Du sitzt im Zentrum der Firma, bekommst direkten Zugang zu Produkt, Kunden und Foundern – und trägst ab Tag eins echte Verantwortung. 🧱 Operational Backbone (≈ 1/3) Du sorgst dafür, dass die Firma rund läuft und sauber mitwächst: Hiring – Du unterstützt den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenanzeigen, Sourcing, Pipeline-Pflege, Terminkoordination und Kandidaten-Kommunikation. Operations – Du hältst unsere internen Abläufe, Tools und Dokumentation in Ordnung und schließt die Lücken, die im Alltag auffallen. Datenschutz & Compliance – Du unterstützt bei Datenschutzthemen: Kundenanfragen und Fragebögen vorbereiten, Dokumente und Verzeichnisse aktuell halten, Fristen im Blick behalten. Produkt-Setups – Du richtest neue Kundenprojekte im Produkt ein, bereitest Projektdaten auf und stellst sicher, dass alles startklar ist. AI-Setup der Company – Du hilfst, unsere internen KI-Workflows aufzubauen und zu pflegen, damit jedes Team mit den besten Tools und Automatisierungen arbeitet. 🚤 Speedboats (≈ 2/3) Du übernimmst schnelle, eigenständige Projekte, die direkt auf Wachstum einzahlen – zum Beispiel: Interne Prozesse mit Notion, Zapier oder n8n automatisieren Go-to-Market-Experimente aufsetzen und neue Kundensegmente testen Kunden-Discovery vorbereiten und Erkenntnisse verdichten Bei Pricing-Fragen und strategischen Analysen zuarbeiten Diese Rolle passt zu jemandem, der unternehmerisch denkt, mit Unsicherheit gut umgehen kann und eine Firma an der Schnittstelle von KI und echter Welt mitbauen will. Requirements Rahmen Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in oder absolvierst ein Pflicht-/freiwilliges Praktikum – idealerweise für mindestens 4–6 Monate , Vollzeit Standort München oder Bereitschaft, für die Dauer des Praktikums von hier aus zu arbeiten Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch Wie du arbeitest Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo. Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht die einzelne Aufgabe, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu machen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht — und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn auch die nächste Person versteht. AI-Fanatiker: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst schon Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Zapier, Lovable, Claude Code o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle und Tools aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine Meinung dazu, was taugt. Struktur im Chaos: Du schaffst Klarheit in unübersichtlichen Situationen – ob durch eine saubere Notion-Seite, einen organisierten Hiring-Funnel oder ein aufgeräumtes Produkt-Setup. Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Themen: Datenschutz und Dokumentation sind für dich kein lästiges Beiwerk – du arbeitest hier genau und zuverlässig. Persönlicher Hintergrund DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden Pluspunkte Du hast bereits erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt – Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, eigenes Projekt oder eine studentische Initiative Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr Du hast bereits selbst KI-Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (z. B. mit Lovable, n8n, Zapier) Du hast schon in einem schnell wachsenden Startup gearbeitet Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve. Warum alago? Die meisten Praktika sind Zuarbeit. Dieses hier ist eine Abkürzung : Du sitzt sechs Monate im Maschinenraum eines Startups, das gerade von elf auf dreißig Leute wächst — und nimmst mit, wofür andere Jahre brauchen. Was du danach kannst Du hast ein Hiring von A bis Z begleitet und weißt, wie man gute Leute findet, bewertet und gewinnt. Du hast interne Systeme selbst gebaut – Automatisierungen, KI-Workflows, Prozesse – und nicht nur bedient. Du hast gesehen, wie ein Produkt bei echten Kunden ankommt, was es kostet und warum Deals gewonnen oder verloren werden. Du kannst erklären, wie eine Firma von innen funktioniert: Finanzen, Recht, Datenschutz, Produkt, Vertrieb – keine Blackbox mehr. Du baust Glaubwürdigkeit auf, bevor deine Kommiliton:innen anfangen Am Ende hast du keine Liste von Aufgaben im Lebenslauf, sondern Ergebnisse mit deinem Namen dran : Prozesse, die laufen, Leute, die du mit eingestellt hast, Automatisierungen, die noch nach dir funktionieren. Genau das ist die Währung, mit der du danach verhandelst. Zwei Türen, die danach offen stehen Eigene Gründung – Du hast aus nächster Nähe gesehen, wie man eine Firma baut: Fundraising, erste Kunden, erste Hires, die Fehler inklusive. Du startest nicht bei null, sondern mit einem inneren Playbook — und mit Zugang zu den Foundern, Coaches und VCs, die dir das ehrlich spiegeln. Der Startup-Job, den man nicht ausgeschrieben bekommt – Wer bei uns liefert, bekommt eine echte Referenz und Türen ins Münchner Startup-Ökosystem geöffnet. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, reden wir am Ende über eine feste Rolle bei alago. Wie du dabei wächst Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) — kein Zwischenlayer, kein Praktikanten-Sonderprogramm. Feedback in kurzen Zyklen: Du bekommst gesagt, was gut läuft und was nicht — wöchentlich, nicht zum Abschlussgespräch. Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen sowie wöchentlichen Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions. Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst. Wir bauen für Skalierung – aber gerade ist es noch früh. Das bedeutet viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, die am besten zu deinen Stärken passt – ob Operations, Product, Growth oder eines Tages die eigene Gründung . Read This Before Joining as Employee 1 to 20 at a Startup von Stacy La (Employee #3 bei Clover Health): https://review.firstround.com/read-this-before-joining-as-employee-1-to-20-at-a-startup First Startup Employees – Erfahrungsberichte von frühen Mitarbeitenden bei Wise, GoCardless, Gousto und mehr: https://sifted.eu/articles/first-startup-employees/ Zusätzlich bieten wir: Perks: Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, zweimal pro Woche gemeinsames Team-Dinner sowie Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess. Standort WERK1: Arbeiten in einem der aktivsten Innovations- und Startup-Hubs Münchens mit direktem Zugang zur Startup-Community. Vergütung: Faire Praktikumsvergütung. Closing 1. Schick uns deine Bewerbung Neben deinem Lebenslauf freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen oder anderen weitergeholfen hast. 2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten) Ein kurzes Kennenlernen mit Janick oder Ann-Christin, um deinen Hintergrund und deine Motivation zu verstehen. Wir erklären dir die Rolle, zeigen das Produkt und beantworten erste Fragen. 3. Case Study / Schnuppertag (halber Tag vor Ort) Besuche uns in München und arbeite mit uns an einer realistischen Aufgabe – z. B. einen Hiring-Funnel strukturieren, ein Produkt-Setup vorbereiten oder eine interne Automatisierung entwerfen. So bekommst du ein echtes Gefühl für die Arbeit, und wir sehen, wie du denkst und kommunizierst. 4. Entscheidung Du erhältst innerhalb von 24 Stunden Rückmeldung. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉 💡 Bewirb dich direkt hier über „Jetzt bewerben“ mit deinem Lebenslauf und deiner Story. title: Medior / Senior Java Software Engineer
description: We are looking for a Software Engineer within Axon Product Development to help us build new functionality and add improvements to our SaaS platform. If you have an eye for writing code and are interested in agile methodologies, we’d like to meet you! Key About Your Role As a Software Engineer within a Scrum team, you use high-quality code to solve complex puzzles. You collaborate with business analysts and test engineers to create new functionality for our customers and add internal improvements to our software. Together with the other members of your Scrum team, you take full responsibility for a vital part of the software. You strive to deliver solid solutions by optimising their performance, usability, testability and maintainability and are proud of the products that you create. You analyse complex problems by actively cooperating with colleagues from various teams and find the best solution by combining different insights. We also embrace AI-assisted software engineering as part of our development lifecycle. Our engineers use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to support activities across the SDLC. From exploring requirements and solution options, to writing and refactoring code, creating tests, debugging, documentation and code review. AI is a development aid, not a substitute for engineering judgement: you are expected to understand the solutions you deliver, validate AI-generated output and remain accountable for its correctness, security, performance and maintainability. As part of a large community of fellow software engineers, you are always looking for opportunities to improve your engineering skills, experiment with better ways of working and continuously improve our software and code base. Key About Your Team The Axon Product Development department consists of more than 120 colleagues, organised across 9 functional clusters (like Claims, Contracts, Financials, Request) and 16 Scrum teams. Together, they extend Axon’s functionality and continuously improve the product, ensuring it evolves in line with the changing needs of insurance companies and continues to deliver lasting value to our customers and their policyholders. Check out our blog posts and videos to see what it is like to work at Keylane. About Keylane Property & Casualty As the leading European supplier of robust, highly configurable and customer-centric SaaS platforms to the insurance industry, Keylane offers solutions that optimise today’s business processes, unburdens our clients and empowers them to be future-fit and agile. With Axon, we aim to foster trust and empower lasting partnerships by providing an all-in-one SaaS platform that ensures a 24/7 uptime for our customers. We provide and implement continuous upgrades at no additional costs, guaranteeing that our customers are able to comply with the latest rules and regulations. Coupled with our commitment to backwards compatibility, we are a partner our clients can rely on with a platform that always delivers. Requirements You are passionate about software engineering. You understand how AI-assisted development fits into the broader software development lifecycle. You can guide coding assistants with clear requirements and context, including through reusable instructions, skills or agents where relevant. You critically review, test and debug AI-generated code. You can identify incorrect assumptions, security vulnerabilities and maintainability issues, and you remain accountable for the logic, architecture, quality and security of what you deliver. Experience with CI/CD practices and integrating AI-assisted development into those workflows is a plus. *A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and reference check are part of the application process. *Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply Benefits Starting with a monthly gross salary for a candidate between €3,500 and € 5,200 (medior) and between €4,300 and € 6,200 (senior) based on 40 hours per week; 8% holiday allowance of your total gross salary; A profit share; A pension scheme, with the option to save extra; Travel reimbursement: Receive a mileage allowance of €0.23 per km or an NS Business Card, which can also be used for personal travel; 24 holiday days (with the option to buy extra) and 7 inclusion days, which can be exchanged with fixed Dutch national holidays, allowing you to take them when you like; Flexibility in working environment. As part of a hybrid working team, you will work partly from home and partly from the office. If you work in the office, a free lunch is waiting for you every day. If you work from home, you will receive a working from home allowance (€ 4 net per day) and internet allowance (€ 35 net per month); The possibility of working remotely from abroad for up to 2 months per year; The possibility to lease a bike through our bike leasing program; A one-year contract that, subject to satisfactory performance, will be converted into a permanent contract; The opportunity to develop yourself at our Academy through courses and training, both professionally and personally; A comprehensive vitality offer to help you stay healthy.
