title: Senior Customer Engineer, Majors - TOLA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Houston, TX</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p> </p> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="t

title: Director of Accounting & Controlling
description: Imagine this. You are building the accounting and controlling backbone behind a fast-growing aerospace and defence company operating across multiple countries, manufacturing sites, and legal entities. As Director of Accounting & Controlling, you will own the integrity of our group financial reporting, set the standard for IFRS and local GAAP compliance, and make sure our numbers are accurate, controlled, scalable, and audit-ready. Reporting directly to the CFO, you will be the group's senior technical accounting authority and a key finance leader across the organization. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage accounting from a distance. You will set the agenda, challenge existing processes, solve complex accounting issues, and drive execution across a distributed international finance organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual group close across all consolidated entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial reporting Own the group close calendar and drive execution across Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and regional finance teams Act as the senior escalation point for complex accounting and close issues, driving them to resolution without compromising reporting quality or timelines Coordinate consolidation adjustments, intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, and other group-level accounting activities Own and continuously strengthen internal accounting controls, policies, and their consistent application across the group Drive improvements to our ERP and finance systems landscape, including Microsoft Dynamics environments, IFRS and local GAAP configurations, regional VAT setups, transfer pricing, intercompany eliminations, and consolidation processes Own group-wide cost accounting standards and methodologies across manufacturing entities, including standard and actual costing, absorption, WIP, and variance analysis Lead the Operations Finance function through the Operations Finance Lead and ensure disciplined capture and reporting of manufacturing costs including labor, overhead, scrap, absorption, and WIP Own the variance bridge process and ensure significant deviations are understood, explained, and assigned to the right accountable teams across Manufacturing, Program Management, Procurement, and Finance Connect Cost Accounting, Operations, Manufacturing, and Program Management so operational drivers such as volume, yield, labor mix, and capacity utilization are reflected in forecasts and budgets Partner closely with FP&A to ensure accounting actuals, forecasts, and budgets remain methodologically aligned as the business scales Own accounting judgments related to inventory, WIP, and program cost capitalization under IAS 2 Govern the group chart of accounts and ensure it remains consistent, scalable, and aligned with consolidation and management reporting requirements Own balance sheet quality across the group, establishing clear standards for account ownership, reconciliations, substantiation, aging, suspense accounts, clearing accounts, and provisions Partner with FP&A and Treasury on working capital, provisions, capex accounting, and other balance sheet forecasting inputs Oversee AP and AR processes across the group, strengthening controls, segregation of duties, cash conversion, and sub-ledger reconciliation Drive DSO and DPO discipline and establish robust policies around credit control, payment terms, and dispute resolution Act as the primary management counterpart for external auditors across group and statutory audits Own audit timelines, PBC processes, technical accounting documentation, and the timely resolution of audit findings Ensure statutory financial statements are accurate and filed on time across jurisdictions in coordination with local teams and external advisors Support lender and investor diligence with accurate, audit-ready financial schedules and clear technical accounting narratives Standardize accounting processes and controls across entities and eliminate unnecessary manual workarounds as the organization grows Partner with IT and ERP teams to build scalable accounting, costing, consolidation, and reporting structures within systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Own group accounting policies, procedures, and SOPs, creating a consistent framework for control, onboarding, and training Build and develop a high-performing accounting and controlling organization across multiple European jurisdictions, setting clear expectations and creating accountability across direct and indirect teams Mentor Controllers and Accounting Managers across the group and act as the technical escalation point when complex accounting decisions need to be made Requirements What You'll Need 10+ years of progressive Accounting, Controlling, or Finance experience, including substantial responsibility within a multi-entity, multi-currency European environment Public company experience is required Deep technical knowledge of IFRS and strong familiarity with local GAAP requirements across European jurisdictions Demonstrated experience owning group accounting policies and making complex technical accounting judgments Proven experience leading group close and consolidation processes at significant scale, ideally within environments exceeding EUR 1 billion in revenue Strong manufacturing cost accounting experience, including standard and actual costing, variance analysis, absorption, inventory, and WIP Experience working closely with Manufacturing and Operations teams, with the ability to connect operational performance with financial outcomes Strong ERP experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, or an equivalent large-scale platform, including exposure to chart-of-accounts design, costing structures, consolidation, and finance transformation Experience leading geographically distributed finance teams and developing senior accounting and controlling professionals Excellent English communication skills, with additional European languages considered an advantage Experience within aerospace, defence, industrial manufacturing, or another regulated and program-driven environment is strongly preferred Experience with statutory reporting requirements across multiple European jurisdictions is a strong advantage Familiarity with program-based revenue recognition, government or institutional customers, and complex manufacturing environments is an advantage. Who You Are You combine technical accounting depth with the drive to get things done. You care about clean numbers, strong controls, and clear ownership, but you also understand that Finance needs to move at the speed of the business. You are comfortable being the person people turn to when the accounting answer is not obvious. You challenge assumptions, translate complex IFRS topics into practical decisions, and know when to go deep and when to move quickly. You think beyond the next close. You build processes, systems, and teams that can support a company as it grows across countries, manufacturing sites, and increasingly complex operations. You work naturally across Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, Manufacturing, Operations, and leadership, and you are persistent about getting decisions and open issues to closure. Most importantly, you build capability around you. You develop strong teams, create accountability, and make sure critical accounting knowledge is embedded across the organization rather than concentrated in one person. title: Observability Engineering Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an Observability Engineering Manager who will lead the development of the distributed tracing or service mesh products as part of our Observability group.</p> <p>Engineering managers at Canonical are always coders who are able to review and lead both architecture and code. They should also be astute judges of character, and comfortable setting expectations and holding colleagues accountable to them. </p> <p>We are building an observability stack that is easy to deploy and operate on Kubernetes. This is part of a broader initiative to deliver the world's best suite of open source tools, where we provide deep integration and automation for best-of-breed open source offerings that cover metrics, logging, telemetry, alerting, tracing and profiling. Our goal is to make observability tools integral and pervasive across software practices .</p> <p>Our implementation of Kubernetes operators is opinionated, resilient, and scalable, providing deep insights out of the box. The user experience is polished and seamless for the end-users, and its administrators will enjoy smooth, lightweight Day 1 and Day 2 operations. We are excited to be improving the state of the art for open-source observability.</p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Kubernetes, and Observability. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.</p> <p>As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.</p> <p>We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role can be home based in the </em><em>EMEA or Americas regions.</em></p> <h2>The role entails</h2> <ul> <li>Manage a distributed team of engineers and its observability portfolio</li> <li>Organize and lead the team’s processes in order to help it achieve its objectives</li> <li>Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members</li> <li>Identify and measure team health indicators</li> <li>Interact with a vibrant community</li> <li>Review code produced by other engineers</li> <li>Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its Observability Stack</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery</li> <li>Professional software development experience, preferably with a track record in open source</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation </li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills </li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2> <ul> <li>Experience as an engineering manager, with a track record of building great, high performance teams  </li> <li>Professional Python development experience</li> <li>A working knowledge of Go</li> <li>Open source contribution experience</li> <li>Interest and experience with container technologies</li> <li>A proven understanding of the importance of observability and monitoring for keeping software running smoothly</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing observability solutions</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer colleagues</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <p> </p>

title: Principal Brand Designer (Spain or Portugal - based role)
description: About the Role At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint. Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation. You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences. What you'll own Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint. Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising) Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets. Build scalable creative systems powered by AI You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently. Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand. You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation. Raise the creative standard across OLX Group As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives. You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose. Translate strategy into brand experiences You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences. You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value. Drive adoption and influence across the organisation Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced. You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards. You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making. Mentor and elevate the craft As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work. You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation. What we're looking for We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally. You create brands that people trust Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time. You think in systems You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables. You bring strategy to life through Design You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact. You're fluent in AI-enabled Design You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential. You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams. You influence without authority You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers. You bring depth of experience You'll likely have: 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills Why join OLX OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses. As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale. This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come. If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you. Hiring Process We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect: First Stage Portfolio & Design Leadership This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges. Second Stage Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands. Third Stage Executive Partnership & Business Impact This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us! Data Process Policy OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.</p> <p>Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.</li> <li>Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.</li> <li>Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.</li> <li>Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.</li> <li>Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.</li> <li>Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.</li> <li>Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.</li> <li>Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.</li> <li>A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.</li> <li>Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.</li> <li>Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.</li> <li>Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.</li> <li>Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.</li> <li>Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks demonstrating contributions to efficient AI systems.</li> <li>Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p>Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. </p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Embedded Control Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers. WHAT YOU WILL DO Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA. Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations. Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design. Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability. WHO YOU ARE You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications. You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols. You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware NICE TO HAVE Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. title: Co-Founder & CTO @ AI Model Efficiency Engine Venture, Berlin
description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up. Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around. We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. Think ten specialists working on ten pieces, rather than one generalist carrying the whole task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted, and brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks. With people already waiting to use the product, we are looking for a technical co-founder to help shape what comes next and bring it into production. About the Role As co-founder and CTO, you will help shape the company as well as its technology. Working alongside the founder as an eye-level partner, you will turn the ambition into an architecture, a product and an engineering team capable of delivering it.a Your remit spans the efficiency engine, the platform beneath it and the people building both. You will lead our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, grow the team and establish the standards that guide its work. You have led engineering before, but stayed close to the code, and want to keep building as your responsibilities grow. Two things define the technical challenge here. Efficiency is the product itself, so routing, fine-tuning, caching, quantization and open-weight serving sit at the heart of the roadmap. Agentic engineering is also central to how we work. You will set the standard for using individual agents and entire agent fleets effectively, building the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to move quickly while retaining sound engineering judgement. There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with relentless intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and look for people who take initiative and see things through. You will have the scope to make consequential decisions early, and the responsibility to turn them into something that works. What you’ll do You will move between architecture, code and company building, setting the technical direction while building the team that delivers it. Lead the engineering team: guide our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, review their work and establish the engineering and operational standards, including on-call and incident response. Build the team: lead technical hiring and decide how engineering grows as the company develops. Set the technical direction: make the architectural calls, shape the roadmap and decide what we build ourselves and where we use existing tools and services. Develop the efficiency engine: bring together routing, semantic and prefix caching, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, distillation, quantization and batching, with inference economics informing each decision. Own open-weight serving: choose and operate vLLM, SGLang or equivalent, including GPU capacity and European hosting, alongside closed providers through a single interface. Make quality measurable: build rigorous eval harnesses and the evidence needed to establish whether a cheaper route still meets the agreed standard. Build the platform underneath it: own the gateway API, provider layer, identity and tenancy, precise usage and cost accounting, secure storage of customer keys and European infrastructure as code, with GDPR and data residency requirements built in. Stay hands-on: write code and play an active part in designing and building the platform and cost-efficiency systems. Develop our agentic engineering setup, from harness design and benchmarking to the agent workflows that help the team ship. Represent the company technically: bring depth and clarity to customer pilots, enterprise security reviews and investor conversations. About You You have grown into engineering leadership without losing the instinct to build. When faced with a difficult problem, you explore what would make it possible and look for a workable path through it, weighing failure modes alongside unit economics. AI has changed how you work, and you have taken the time to understand where it helps, where it fails and how to use it well. We are looking for depth in five areas: Engineering leadership: you have been a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering or engineering lead, ideally in a startup. You have hired and led engineers, established standards and taken responsibility for both the architecture and what the team shipped. Backend and platform engineering: you bring deep experience in distributed systems, API design, streaming, Postgres, Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud operations, with a broad understanding of what makes a platform reliable and scalable. You have taken systems into production, operated them under significant load and worked through incidents yourself. LLM cost efficiency: you have reduced costs in a production system and can explain the numbers, the decisions behind them and the trade-offs involved. Your experience covers techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA, routing, caching, quantization, distillation and batching, grounded in an understanding of serving economics. Open-weight models in production: you have served, tuned, evaluated and operated open models under load, including the GPU and capacity decisions that come with them. Agentic engineering: you build on strong coding fundamentals, with practical experience running agent fleets and designing and benchmarking their harnesses. You can reason independently about the code they produce and take responsibility for its quality. You also bring a disciplined approach to LLM benchmarking: thoughtful eval design, statistical honesty and a willingness to reproduce results before relying on them. Fluent English is required; German is a plus. Nice to have A strong open-source record, particularly in AI infrastructure or inference, with real users. Experience with LiteLLM, NVIDIA NIM, TGI, llama.cpp or similar, and with self-hosted or air-gapped enterprise deployments. Experience with European cloud providers such as Scaleway, Hetzner or OVH. Experience working in startups tackling similar technical challenges. Why Join With the pre-seed round closed and the first steps already taken, you will join at a point where there is momentum to build on and considerable room to shape what comes next. You will build alongside the founder, choose and grow the engineering team, and receive co-founder equity in the business you help create. The architecture, efficiency engine, security model and engineering culture are all still yours to shape. The decisions you make now will become the foundations for everything that follows. We are entering a market where competitors have larger teams, more funding and an earlier start. Our conviction is that technical depth, focused decisions and a small team that works well together give us a meaningful opportunity to compete. For the right person, that is an interesting challenge to take on, with substantial ownership over how we approach it. This is a full-time commitment, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. title: Solutions Architecture Lead
description: AMPECO is one of the most innovative companies in the area of electric vehicle charging infrastructure - an industry that aims to change the world by making charging easier for everyone. Our product - the AMPECO EV Charging Platform - is a business-critical SaaS platform used by companies to manage their EV charging infrastructure, processes and energy use. It’s already in use by companies all over the world, from North and South America to Europe, Asia and Australia. Our team is highly motivated, capable, and committed to our mission. We are looking to expand it with like-minded, capable people, eager to give, learn and grow with us. When the project is complete, you will hand them over smoothly to a business-as-usual setup. As existing customers take on new integrations or complex initiatives, you might again lead the planning and delivery. Why this role matters This role is highly visible and carries real technical authority. You will be the senior strategic and technical voice for customers at the most critical point in their relationship with AMPECO. We are looking for someone who is equally confident in business and technical conversations, and who can turn complex requirements into clear, achievable plans. description: Wil jij jouw vindingrijke expertise inzetten voor de overgang van traditionele cloud naar autonome AI-platformen? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Jouw bijdrage aan het avontuur We staan aan de vooravond van een enorme technologische versnelling en zetten vol in op onze 'agentic bet'. Als Senior Agentic Platform Engineer bouw jij de cruciale infrastructuur (het substraat) waarop onze Senior AI Engineers en Data Scientists hun productie-agents bouwen. Dit is geen code-generatieprobleem dat we aan AI kunnen overlaten; het is een hoogwaardig architecturaal vraagstuk. Jij bepaalt wat 'goed' betekent voor een agent in productie. Wat betekent dit precies? Eigenaarschap van de core AI-infra: In deze rol ben je de eigenaar van de evaluation harness, agent tracing, de prompt- en tool-registry (waaronder het MCP-protocol) en de routing layer voor model calls. Transformatie naar SaaS: Daarnaast transformeer je onze DevOps-omgeving naar een modern SaaS-landschap waarin agent observability, model gateways en agent-aware deploy patterns de standaard zijn. Modernisering & DevOps: Naast deze innovatieve AI-infrastructuur neem je de lead in het moderniseren en onderhouden van onze huidige pipelines en core DevOps-taken. Vandaag bestaat het operationele portfolio uit 8 assets. Met 4 assets in aanbouw en een duidelijke groeistrategie bouwen we dit uit naar circa 25 operationele assets in 2032. Jij speelt een sleutelrol in die transitie: van een nationaal portfolio naar een internationaal, datagedreven en gestandaardiseerd operating model waarin assets en teams over landen heen optimaal samenwerken en presteren. Jouw rol Als Business Unit Director OtO ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor een internationaal portfolio van operationele assets én voor de organisatie die dit portfolio naar de volgende fase van professionalisering en schaalbare groei brengt. Je bepaalt de strategische koers, investeringsprioriteiten en operationele standaarden, en geeft direct leiding aan de Asset Managers/Regiomanagers en de managers van de centrale teams (nu 35-40 fte, groeiend naar 100 fte). Je begeleidt de groei van 8 operationele units, via de 4 assets die momenteel in aanbouw zijn, naar circa 25 assets in 2032. Je geeft direct leiding aan Asset Managers/Regiomanagers en de managers van de centrale teams. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een sterke bezetting, ontwikkeling van leiderschap en een veilige werkomgeving. Je stelt de operationele en financiële kaders, governance-structuren en mandaten binnen de business unit vast en bouwt deze verder uit met het oog op de internationale groei. Je bouwt het portfolio uit tot een datagedreven operatie: één asset-managementomgeving over alle landen, uniforme instrumentatie en datakwaliteit per plant en cross-plant benchmarking op basis van actuele meetdata in plaats van rapportages achteraf. title: Senior Product Developer
description: Take the lead on innovative CO₂ technologies: from idea to global impact! Are you an experienced technical professional who takes complex technologies to the next level? Do you want to take overall responsibility for the development and standardisation of innovative carbon capture solutions that are implemented worldwide? If so, we can offer you a key role within one of the fastest-growing technologies of the energy transition. About HoSt Group & Bright Renewables HoSt Group is a global leader in the development and implementation of high-tech systems for the production of renewable energy from waste streams. With projects in more than 45 countries and offices in the Netherlands, France, Poland, Latvia and the US, amongst others, we contribute every day to the energy transition and a cleaner world. As a family-run business, founded in 1991, we combine innovation with a down-to-earth approach. We give our people the space to grow, show initiative and contribute to a sustainable future. Bright Renewables is a supplier of technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture, offering global solutions from production to maintenance. As part of the HoSt Group, we work with over 600 colleagues worldwide, 300 of whom are based at our head office in Enschede. The role As a Senior Product Developer at Bright Renewables, you will be part of a multidisciplinary business unit comprising more than 80 professionals. Based at our office in Enschede, you will work in a small team of four within Product Management and report to the Product Management Manager. In this role, you will be the driving force behind the further development and standardisation of our sustainable technologies. You will draw up product development plans, monitor the associated budgets and act as the first point of contact for product standards in relation to Engineering, Sales, Site Support and our suppliers. In doing so, you will work closely with colleagues from Project Management, Engineering, Software and Sales. Your responsibilities As a Senior Product Developer, you will have overall responsibility for the further development of our Carbon Capture technology. You will help shape the product strategy, translate market developments into technical innovations and steer the product development roadmap. In doing so, you will have a significant say in investment decisions, standardisation issues and technological decision-making. Your responsibilities will include: Drawing up the annual product development plan and monitoring the associated budget; Taking ownership of the technical standards and long-term development of our Carbon Capture technology; Initiating and implementing product improvements, new functionalities and technical standards that contribute to the further professionalisation and scalability of our Carbon Capture technology; Carrying out technical analyses and identifying opportunities for improvement to continuously optimise the performance, reliability, cost-efficiency and standardisation of our systems; Managing product development and maintenance activities, monitoring progress, setting priorities and ensuring timely decision-making and delivery; ·Acting as a technical sparring partner for Sales on commercial and strategic customer issues. Building and maintaining strategic partnerships with international suppliers and technology partners. What are we looking for? A completed technical degree at Master’s level (e.g. Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or similar); At least 5 to 8 years’ practical experience in a technical product development environment, or a background in engineering; Experience of independently managing complex development projects and making technical decisions at product level; Experience of stakeholder management within multidisciplinary and international organisations is an advantage. A proactive and committed approach to work, with a pragmatic mindset; A results-oriented approach and the drive to achieve success together with the team; A good command of both Dutch and English. What makes this role attractive? In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the direction of an international applied technology platform. You will have a direct influence on the technical direction of our Carbon Capture solutions and will work alongside experienced specialists on the next generation of sustainable energy systems. Binnen onze business unit Own to Operate exploiteren we onze eigen installaties. Op deze locaties verwerken we biomassa en organische reststromen tot groene energie. Het geproduceerde biogas wordt ingezet voor de productie van duurzame energie en de uitgaande reststromen worden afgezet als alternatieve meststof of kunstmestvervanger. Own to Operate is volop in ontwikkeling. Naast de bestaande installaties in Nederland groeit ook onze aanwezigheid in Duitsland. Ontwikkelen, verbeteren en valideren van analysemethoden en het uitbreiden van de mogelijkheden van het laboratorium. Bewaken van de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en reproduceerbaarheid van laboratoriumresultaten. Opbouwen en verder professionaliseren van het nieuwe laboratorium in Waalwijk, waarbij je meedenkt over apparatuur, werkwijzen en analysemethoden. Samenwerken met Process Engineers, operators, Plant Managers en projectteams om laboratoriumresultaten te verbinden aan de praktijk. Op termijn oppakken van een coördinerende en verantwoordelijke rol binnen het laboratorium. Je hebt daarbij veel ruimte om zelf mee te bepalen hoe het laboratorium zich ontwikkelt en welke rol het binnen HoSt gaat spelen. Wat vragen wij? Twijfel je of je precies aan alle eisen voldoet, maar herken je jezelf sterk in de combinatie van procestechnologie, laboratoriumwerk en procesverbetering? Dan komen we graag met je in contact. title: Systems Engineer, MAPS
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2><ul><li>Austin, US</li></ul><h2>About the Role</h2><p>Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.</p><p>Cloudflare engineering delivers multiple products and features to production at a tremendous pace, and depends on real time load balancing and long term capacity planning to do so with high performance and efficiency. The MAPS team is responsible for highly granular and large-scale resource usage instrumentation and measurement of Cloudflare's edge platform.  The team builds and runs data pipelines, as well as systems and libraries for measuring and collecting the data, and collaborates closely across the range of teams that build and run services on Cloudflare's global edge network to ensure consistent, complete, and correct attribution of all resource usage.</p><p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p><p>We are looking for highly motivated software engineers to join our MAPS team.  You’ll have a strong programming background with a deep understanding and experience developing and maintaining  distributed systems. You’ll need to be able to communicate effectively with engineers across the company to understand the behaviours of our systems and products in order to deliver tooling to meet their testing needs. You will also work closely with product managers to support our public facing synthetic testing and load testing products for enterprise customers.</p><h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2><ul><li>Experience as a software engineer or similar role working on latency and efficiency sensitive server infrastructure.</li><li>Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and processing, including use of distributed column-oriented data storage and processing such as ClickHouse, BigQuery/Dremel, etc.</li><li>Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and routing basics</li><li>Successful track record of collaborating with many teams concurrently to achieve goals that require alignment across a range of teams and orgs.</li><li>Track record of owning problems, goals, and outcomes - not (just) specific pieces of software.</li><li>Track record of building long-term sustainable, maintainable systems.</li><li>Ability to dive deep into technical specifics of systems and codebases, while always keeping the big picture in mind.</li><li>Experience with one or more of the following programming languages: Go, Rust, C</li></ul><h2>Bonus Points</h2><ul><li>Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals, especially any of: networking, scheduling, resource isolation, virtualization</li><li>Experience troubleshooting and resolving performance issues in large-scale distributed systems.</li><li>Experience with large scale configuration/deployment management.</li></ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Portland, OR<br></strong></h3> <hr> <p><strong>About the Role </strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. AI Knowledge:</strong> Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li> <li><strong>Coding/Scripting:</strong> Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <div You will work in a feature team developing solutions that directly impact healthcare professionals and patients across Europe, contributing to our Operating System powered by AI to manage all clinical and administrative activities.</p> <p>Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.</p> <h2><strong>What and collaboration by sharing knowledge and engaging actively with your team</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>You'll be a great fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You love problem-solving and are driven by curiosity — you're not afraid to dive into complex issues and find creative solutions</li> <li>You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with cross-functional teams, sharing knowledge, and learning from your peers</li> <li>You have a passion for technology and product development, and always keep the user experience in mind</li> <li>You are comfortable coding, with the help of AI agents like Claude Code, in multiple languages and eager to learn our tech stack</li> <li>You are in your final year of a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field and looking for a 6-month full-time internship</li> <li>Eager to learn and work in a team of builders</li> <li>You are fluent in English</li> </ul> <p><strong>It would be fantastic if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have experience with web development or building products in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Have worked on side projects or contributed to open-source communities</li> <li>Are familiar with AI-assisted coding tools and eager to integrate them into your daily workflow.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Life at Doctolib Tech</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.</li> <li>Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.</li> <li>We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision <a href="https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/">here</a>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the</em><a href="https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/"><em> </em><em>Doctolib Tech site</em></a><em>.</em></p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Tech masterclasses throughout the internship</li> <li>Free breakfast at the office</li> <li>Access to the best AI tools for coding and development, along with dedicated training</li> <li>Discounted membership to Urban Sports Club</li> <li>Meal vouchers worth €8.50 per day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib</li> <li>50% reimbursement of public transportation subscriptions</li> <li>Comprehensive health insurance, fully covered by Doctolib for employees and their children under the basic plan</li> <li>Free mental health and personalised coaching programme with our partner, <a href="http://moka.care/">Moka.care</a></li> <li>A comprehensive three-month onboarding programme, including Doctolib Academy and various training courses in languages, soft skills, and technical skills</li> <li>A works council subsidy providing partial reimbursement for sports or leisure activity memberships</li> <li>For employees with disabilities or caregiving responsibilities, a support package including adapted remote-working arrangements, paid authorised leave for medical appointments, and enhanced psychological support</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our interview process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coding Game (1h)</li> <li>Recruiter Interview (30 minutes)</li> <li>Feature Building Interview (1h)</li> <li>Behavioral Interview (1h)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Job details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Internship (6 months)</li> <li>Paris (Levallois)</li> <li>Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)</li> <li>Start date: March 2027</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We welcome everyone</strong></h2> <p>At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.</p> <p>The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.</p> <p>To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.</p> <p>Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!</p> <h2><strong>Your data privacy</strong></h2> <p>All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management.</p> <p>For data processing details, click here:<a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-DE"> Germany</a> |<a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR"> France</a> |<a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-IT"> Italy</a> |<a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-COM"> Netherlands</a>.</p> <p>Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
