toward consent within the team. </li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive best practices and standardization:  <ul> <li>Promote and evolve SBP best practices instead of reinventing the wheel.</li> <li>Help define reusable platforms, patterns, and reference architectures.</li> <li>Decide when to go “custom” and when to standardize, based on customer value rather than technical curiosity.</li> <li>Work closely with other experts (e.g. security leads, data protection leads) to ensure a “whole system in the room” approach. </li> </ul> </li> <li>Ensure high standards and quality (plan–build–run):  <ul> <li>Support agile ways of working to keep the team focused on the right priorities.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Be a trusted advisor:  <ul> <li>Deepen your understanding of the customer’s business domain and apply that context to technical decisions. </li> <li>Ask the question behind the question to get to the real problem. </li> <li>Help customers think strategically about businesstoIT challenges, sometimes even concluding that SBP is not the right party for a specific need.</li> <li>Work with a wide range of stakeholders: executives, product owners, architects, and engineers. </li> </ul> </li> <li>Support commercial success:  <ul> <li>Participate in sales and presales activities as the technical counterpart to Customer Director Sales and Customer Director Delivery.</li> <li>Assess the scope, complexity, and required team composition for projects and services.</li> <li>Contribute to and understand commercial and cost models, ensuring that what we propose is realistic and deliverable by your team.</li> <li>Help identify and develop new opportunities with your customer based on their strategic needs. </li> </ul> </li> <li>Carry our “Tech for Good” mindset:  <ul> <li>Explore IT challenges from a business and societal perspective, not just a technical one.</li> <li>Prioritize customer impact and long-term sustainability over short-term gains.</li> <li>Consider the impact of your decisions on people’s lives, families and future generations; “leaving the world a better place for our kids” is part of your compass. </li> </ul> </li> <li>Grow others and the company:  <ul> customer team informed about relevant topics from the Tech Lead community and how they affect their work</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>What you’ll bring </h3> <p>We’re looking for an experienced explain your choices clearly. </li> </ul> </li> <li>Leadership by influence, not hierarchy: <br> <ul> <li>You’re comfortable stepping forward and taking the lead in discussions when needed.</li> title: Senior Platform Engineer (Kubernetes)
description: <blockquote>Bouw aan de cloud-native platformen achter de meest kritische systemen van onze klanten</blockquote> <p>Bij Schuberg Philis zijn we gespecialiseerd in mission-critical IT. We werken nauw samen met onze klanten om ervoor te zorgen dat hun meest vitale systemen veilig, schaalbaar en altijd beschikbaar zijn. Onze engineers zijn T-shaped professionals: mensen met diepe expertise én brede technische interesse, die samen verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor het resultaat.</p> <p>Als <strong>Senior Platform Engineer</strong> werk je aan de ontwikkeling en het beheer van meerdere moderne platformen, Je werkt in een team dat bouwt aan cloud-native platformen op Azure, private cloud-omgevingen en toekomstige data-platformen. Daarbij zoeken we geen specialist die slechts één technologie beheerst, maar een sterke engineer die complexe vraagstukken over infrastructuur, containers, cloud en automatisering weet samen te brengen.</p> <p>Je werkt nauw samen met zowel Schuberg Philis-collega's als engineers van de klant om betrouwbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige platformen te bouwen.</p> <p><strong>De verantwoordelijkheden kunnen variëren afhankelijk van het project en de focus van het team, maar kunnen onder andere omvatten:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ontwerpen, bouwen, beheren en optimaliseren van Kubernetes-platformen in productieomgevingen.</li> <li>Implementeren en verbeteren van cloud-native oplossingen binnen Azure, private cloud- en hybride omgevingen.</li> <li>Beheren van de volledige lifecycle van Kubernetes-clusters, waaronder upgrades, scaling, security en platformverbeteringen.</li> <li>Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van automatiseringsoplossingen met Infrastructure as Code en GitOps-principes.</li> <li>Verbeteren van observability, monitoring, logging en alerting om de betrouwbaarheid van mission-critical platformen te waarborgen.</li> <li>Samenwerken met engineeringteams landschap.</li> <li>Actief bijdragen aan de continue verbetering van architectuur, processen en engineering standaarden.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat je meebrengt</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimaal 3 jaar of Google Cloud.</li> <li>Een sterke achtergrond in Linux, infrastructuur en open source technologieën.</li> <li>Ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD en automatisering.</li> <li>Je begrijpt hoe missie-kritische systemen ontworpen, beheerd en geoptimaliseerd moeten worden.</li> <li>Je bent een pragmatische engineer die nieuwe technologie snel eigen maakt en complexe problemen gestructureerd oplost.</li> <li>Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ervaring met Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon EKS of vergelijkbare title: Senior Network Engineer - Mission-Critical Infrastructure
description: <p>Full-time · Rotterdam · 32-40 hours · 3 dagen per week op kantoor</p> <h3><strong>Ontwerp, bouw, automatiseer én run netwerken die er echt toe doen</strong></h3> <p>Bij Schuberg Philis houden we van experts die every step of the way in de lead zijn. We zijn nadrukkelijk niet op zoek naar een architect die alleen ontwerpt en zijn werk overdraagt aan anderen voor uitvoering. Wij geloven dat de beste, meest toekomstbestendige oplossingen ontstaan wanneer dezelfde engineer ontwerpt, bouwt, automatiseert én runt.</p> <p>Als Senior Network (Automation) Engineer ben jij eigenaar van het netwerk — van idee tot realiteit, en alles wat daarna komt. Je werkt door alle lagen heen, van fabric tot cloud overlay, en automation is je default.</p> <h3>Wat ga je doen?</h3> <p>Je werkt aan complexe, missie-kritische netwerkinfrastructuren voor klanten waar downtime écht iets kost. Je bent betrokken vanaf het begin en blijft betrokken zolang het systeem draait. Concreet betekent dit dat je:</p> <ul> <li>Highly available, secure en scalable netwerken architecteert, ontwerpt, bouwt én onderhoudt, zowel on-premises als in de public cloud (Azure)</li> <li>Door de volle stack werkt: van routing en switching (BGP, OSPF, EVPN/VXLAN) tot firewalling, load balancing, SDN en VMware NSX</li> <li>Netwerkconfiguraties automatiseert en templatet volgens Infrastructure-as-Code-principes, met Terraform, Ansible en Chef</li> <li>IPAM (bij voorkeur Nautobot of NetBox) en IAM integreert en beheert als source of truth voor je automation</li> <li>Werkt aan Kubernetes-netwerkvraagstukken, CI/CD-automatisering en GitLab/GitOps-workflows</li> <li>Zelf performance- en security issues onderzoekt en oplost in complexe netwerklandschappen</li> <li>Bijdraagt aan change planning, security-incidenten, audits en continue verbetering</li> <li>Greenfield projecten draait, met verantwoordelijkheid van architectuur tot hands-on build en doorontwikkeling</li> </ul> <p>Geen losse taken, geen overdrachten — jij bouwt wat je ontwerpt en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor hoe het draait.</p> <h3>Wat heb je nodig om succesvol te zijn?</h3> <p>Deze rol past bij jou als je een ervaren, hands-on Network Engineer bent die verantwoordelijkheid neemt en graag zelf bouwt.</p> <p>Je brengt mee:</p> <ul> <li>Een bewezen senior track record als Network Engineer in high-availability omgevingen</li> <li>Hands-on ervaring met Cisco, Arista en/of Extreme Networks</li> <li>Diepe kennis van F5, Cisco ASA en Palo Alto</li> <li>Ervaring met automatisering en Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible, Chef (Python of Go is zeker een plus)</li> <li>Ervaring met public cloud networking (Azure) en de integratie met on-premises netwerken</li> <li>Sterke troubleshooting skills — je lost complexe netwerk- en securityproblemen zelfstandig op</li> <li>Nederlands en Engels op professioneel niveau: je schakelt met Nederlandstalige stakeholders, onze technische documentatie is Engelstalig</li> <li>Je woont in Nederland. De standplaats is Rotterdam en je bent minimaal 3 dagen per week op kantoor. We bieden geen relocatie of visumsponsoring en nemen geen sollicitaties vanuit het buitenland in behandeling</li> </ul> <p>Belangrijker dan elk vinkje is dat je het logisch vindt om te zeggen: <em>"Als ik dit ontwerp, dan wil ik het ook zelf bouwen, automatiseren en beheren."</em></p> <h3><strong>Voor wie is dit de juiste rol?</strong></h3> <p>Voor de senior netwerkengineer die genoeg heeft van tickets afhandelen op andermans ontwerp. Die door alle lagen heen wil blijven werken in plaats van te specialiseren in één laag of één vendor. En die automation niet als project ziet, maar als manier van werken.</p> <p>Nieuwsgierig of deze rol bij je past, of heb je nog vragen? At this moment we are not providing relocation sponsorships.</em></p> <p>At Schuberg Philis, we specialize in <a href="https://schubergphilis.com/en/stories/jan-jacob-bos-on-being-a-mission-critical-engineer-and-an-ingredient-critical-hobby-chef">mission-critical IT</a>, partnering closely with our customers to ensure their most vital systems run smoothly and securely. title: Senior Kubernetes Engineer
description: <blockquote>Maak het verschil in mission-critical Kubernetes-omgevingen.</blockquote> <p>Bij Schuberg Philis zijn we gespecialiseerd in <a href="https://schubergphilis.com/en/stories/jan-jacob-bos-on-being-a-mission-critical-engineer-and-an-ingredient-critical-hobby-chef">mission-critical IT</a>, We werken nauw samen met onze klanten om ervoor te zorgen dat hun meest vitale systemen veilig en soepel blijven draaien. Onze engineers zijn T‑shaped professionals: mensen met diepe expertise én brede vaardigheden, die samenwerken om 100% klanttevredenheid te realiseren. </p> <p>Als Senior Kubernetes Engineer werk je nauw samen met zowel je eigen team als engineers van de klant. title: Proposition Director Delivery - Software
description: <p> </p> <p>Bij Schuberg Philis draait alles om eigenaarschap. Onze missie kritische dienstverlening vraagt om leiders die niet alleen visie brengen, maar deze ook vertalen naar concreet, voorspelbaar en schaalbaar resultaat.</p> <p>Als <strong>Software</strong> <strong>Proposition Director</strong> ben jij zo’n leider. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige lifecycle van onze software‑gedreven marktproposities: van plan en build tot run en continue verbetering. Je zorgt dat klantteams kunnen leveren wat wij gezamenlijk beloven: de hoogste kwaliteit, zonder compromissen.</p> <p>Dit is een rol voor een hands‑on deliveryleider die zich thuis voelt op het snijvlak van strategie, techniek en operatie.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Wat jij brengt:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je bent voelt je thuis binnen complexe IT-landschappen. Je kent het domein Software van binnen en van buiten en snapt als geen ander hoe onze klanten hier waarde uithalen Je bent analytisch scherp, een snelle denker en je maakt makkelijk verbinding tussen technische en organisatorische zaken.</li> <li>Je denkt in oplossingen en hebt inhoudelijke scherpte. Je weet wat nodig is om de kwaliteit van Schuberg Philis te leveren: je kijkt vooral naar hoe iets wel kan. Het resultaat is net zo belangrijk als de weg er naartoe. Je creëert waarde</li> <li>Je voelt je thuis op alle niveaus: van engineer tot C-level. Je brengt rust door je overzicht en voorspellend inzicht. Je stelt de vragen die anderen niet durven te stellen. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen de behoefte van de klant vandaag en van morgen door te luisteren, te duiden en samen te ontwerpen.</li> <li>Je bent ondernemend en handelt resultaatgericht. Je haalt energie uit samenwerken en bouwen, met de juiste kwaliteit. Je kijkt verder dan de vraag van vandaag en bouwt aan oplossingen die passen bij de langere termijn ambitie van de Schuberg Philis.</li> <li>Jij bent ervan. Je weet dat elk project begint met écht begrijpen wat er speelt. Dat betekent dat je de spin in het web bent waar alles samen komt: het leveren van de dienstverlening die onze teams sneller en efficiënter maakt, kwaliteit, innovatie, team well-being. Je bent met jouw team verantwoordelijk voor de P&L van de Software propositie. Je bent de hoeder van ons DNA en onze manier van werken.</li> <li>Je bent een natuurlijke verbinder. Je bouwt snel een netwerk op binnen Schuberg Philis en weet teams en collega’s bij elkaar te brengen om de juiste Services te creëren en te adopteren.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong> </strong><strong>Wat je gaat doen</strong></p> <p>Operationeel Leiderschap & Delivery Excellence; Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de levering en doorontwikkeling van onze Services. Dat betekent:</p> <ul> <li>Regie voeren over de plan, build en run en doorlopende verbetering van onze diensten.</li> <li>Structuur aanbrengen met duidelijke roadmaps, mijlpalen en transparante interne communicatie.</li> <li>Processen standaardiseren, documenteren en best practices laten landen, zodat onze dienstverlening schaalbaar en audit‑proof is.</li> <li>Servicebeschrijvingen, contracten en pricing actueel houden ter ondersteuning van sales en klantteams.</li> </ul> <p>Customer Enablement & Service Ownership; Je ondersteunt klantteams zodat zij duurzaam kunnen leveren:</p> <ul> <li>Door een stabiele, hoogwaardige basis aan diensten neer te zetten.</li> <li>Door teams te verbinden en communities te creëren die kennisdeling en inner‑source stimuleren.</li> <li>Door operationele knelpunten te herkennen en structurele verbeteringen organisatiebreed te realiseren.</li> </ul> <p>Commercieel & Financieel Eigenaarschap; Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de commerciële gezondheid van jouw domein:</p> <ul> <li>Managen van de P&L van de propositie en zorgen dat investeringen maximaal renderen.</li> <li>Bijdragen aan cross‑ en up‑sell door proposities te laten aansluiten op klantbehoefte en marktontwikkelingen.</li> <li>Samenwerken met proposition ambassadors en sales om klantfeedback te vertalen naar onze service roadmap.</li> </ul> <p>Innovatie‑Enablement & Stewardship; Je borgt dat innovatie ook echt landt in onze dienstverlening:</p> <ul> <li>Door nauw samen te werken met labs, tech leads en klantteams.</li> <li>Door nieuwe trends, technieken en werkwijzen op een duurzame manier in dienstverlening te integreren.</li> <li>Door hergebruik van servicecomponenten te stimuleren en onze schaalbaarheid te maximaliseren.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Wat je meeneemt </strong></p> <p>Je bent een gedreven, gestructureerde en zeer betrouwbare deliveryleider. Je combineert strategisch inzicht met pragmatische uitvoering en weet complexe dienstverlening voorspelbaar te maken.</p> <p><strong>Je bent:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimaal 10 jaar delivery van complexe IT- of technologieomgevingen.</li> <li>Ervaring met product management in een IT dienstenomgeving</li> <li>Vergaande affiniteit met IT en technologie</li> <li>Hands‑on, met een sterk gevoel voor mission‑critical verantwoordelijkheid.</li> <li>Organized & detail‑driven, met een natuurlijke focus op kwaliteit en structuur.</li> <li>Commercieel scherp, met begrip van klantwaarde en technische mogelijkheden.</li> <li>Een verbinder, die communities bouwt en stakeholders meeneemt.</li> <li>Een steward van excellentie, die continu betere manieren van werken introduceert.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Wat je krijgt<br></strong>Een rol die groter is dan delivery alleen. Bij Schuberg Philis werk je niet in een silo’s, maar in een multidisciplinair team van engineers, architecten en strategen. Samen bouwen jullie aan verandering die ertoe doet voor klanten, voor Nederland, en voor de continuïteit van systemen die nooit stil mogen vallen.</p> <p>Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen koers te varen, met de support van een sterk merk, bewezen proposities en cases die gewicht hebben. Je werkt autonoom, maar nooit alleen. En ja, de lat ligt hoog. Maar dat is precies waarom jij hier wilt zijn.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. </em><br><em> </em><br><em>It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <blockquote><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun" data-ccp-charstyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"961a4c69-80b3-4106-8b97-6626409b2a4b|52","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",469777841,"Calibri",469777842,"Arial",469777843,"Calibri",469777844,"Calibri",201341986,"1",469769226,"Calibri,Arial",268442635,"22",469775450,"normaltextrun",201340122,"1",134233614,"true",469778129,"normaltextrun",335572020,"1",469778324,"Default Paragraph Font"]}">Take ownership of our DMS platform for managing data protection needs</span></span></blockquote> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun" data-ccp-charstyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"961a4c69-80b3-4106-8b97-6626409b2a4b|52","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",469777841,"Calibri",469777842,"Arial",469777843,"Calibri",469777844,"Calibri",201341986,"1",469769226,"Calibri,Arial",268442635,"22",469775450,"normaltextrun",201340122,"1",134233614,"true",469778129,"normaltextrun",335572020,"1",469778324,"Default Paragraph Font"]}"><em>Please note: At this point we are only considering applications from candidates currently based in the Netherlands. </em></span></span></p> <p><em><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Subtle Emphasis">Are you passionate about data protection and security in a rapidly evolving digital landscape? At Schuberg Philis, we recognize that the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Subtle Emphasis">We’re</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Subtle Emphasis"> looking for a Platform Engineer – Backup & Recovery to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Subtle Emphasis">accelerate through this </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Subtle Emphasis">transformation.</span></span></em><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":259}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Subtitle Char">About the Team</span></span> </strong><br><span data-contrast="auto">The DMS team is responsible for ensuring business continuity and peace of mind for more than 20 of our customers by delivering highly available, secure, and robust data recovery platforms. Our shared platform is fully segregated and consumed by customer teams via a self-service model, securing critical data and guaranteeing recoverability across both private and public cloud environments.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You'll join a dedicated, group of <span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun" data-ccp-charstyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"ac0262f4-8a9e-5820-b908-2d943c5f7113|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",469777841,"Calibri",469777842,"",469777843,"Calibri",469777844,"Calibri",201341986,"1",469769226,"Calibri",268442635,"22",469775450,"normaltextrun",201340122,"1",134233614,"true",469778129,"normaltextrun",335572020,"1",469778324,"Default Paragraph Font"]}">passioned</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> data security experts</span> working within our larger Services Team. You’ll also work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. Here, you will dive into complex customer environments and support customer teams by providing strategic advice for optimal solutions, collaborate in RFIs/RFPs, and conduct in-depth data management assessments. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Subtitle Char">Your Role</span></span> </strong><br><span data-contrast="auto">As a Platform Engineer - Backup & Recovery, you will take full responsibility for the lifecycle of both existing and future environments, platforms, and solutions. Your focus: continuously improving platform features, driving innovation, and enhancing user experience. Working closely with technology vendors and our customer teams, you’ll ensure all data protection and resiliency standards are not only met, but exceeded, all while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and best-in-class practices.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our DMS platform is run on a segregated, dedicated private cloud infrastructure managed in-house for maximum resilience, spanning multiple availability zones. We integrate a wide array of storage targets, including public cloud services and S3-compatible platforms built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Serving over 4,000 data protection endpoints ranging from Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, and container platforms to VMs on various public/private clouds, our environments generate more than 25,000 recovery points daily, maximizing data integrity and uptime for critical applications.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":259}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Your passion for data protection and automation should simplify day-2 operations and drive cost-effectiveness, leaving room for implementing new security features and streamlining (new) customer deployments and </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">facilitating</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> new projects. title: Customer Director Sales
description: <blockquote> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun" data-ccp-charstyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"ac0262f4-8a9e-5820-b908-2d943c5f7113|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",469777841,"Aptos",469777842,"Arial",469777843,"Aptos",469777844,"Aptos",201341986,"1",469769226,"Aptos,Arial",268442635,"24",469775450,"normaltextrun",201340122,"1",134233614,"true",469778129,"normaltextrun",335572020,"1",469778324,"Default Paragraph Font"]}"><em>Wij groeien mee met de vitale industrieën van Nederland — van Financial Services en Asset Management tot Energy, Manufacturing, Retail, Public, Government, Transport en Logistics — en zoeken collega’s die met ons het verschil willen maken.</em></span></span></p> </blockquote> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun" data-ccp-charstyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"ac0262f4-8a9e-5820-b908-2d943c5f7113|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",469777841,"Aptos",469777842,"Arial",469777843,"Aptos",469777844,"Aptos",201341986,"1",469769226,"Aptos,Arial",268442635,"24",469775450,"normaltextrun",201340122,"1",134233614,"true",469778129,"normaltextrun",335572020,"1",469778324,"Default Paragraph Font"]}">Ruim 20 jaar geleden is ons mooie bedrijf opgericht. Onze </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">founders</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> wilden breken met de traditionele werkwijze van </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">IT bedrijven</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> door onconventioneel te werk te gaan en te denken. Met altijd de </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">basis-vraag</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> “Wat nou, als we ons werk gaan doen zoals we het eigenlijk willen doen?” En daar zit onze kracht. Als je dingen gaat doen zoals ze </span></span><em><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">eigenlijk</span></span></em><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> gedaan moeten worden, dan volg je niet automatisch processen, dan ga je niet mee in de geijkte paden. Nee, dan kijk je eerst naar de uitdaging, je loopt er omheen, je overweegt verschillende perspectieven om tot de allerbeste en meest service- en doelgerichte oplossing voor de klant te komen en geeft dan pas je definitieve advies. Sindsdien is ons streven altijd 100% klanttevredenheid geweest. Want als je steeds voor een matig zesje gaat, dan heb je niet het gezamenlijke gesprek over de toekomst, maar moet je steeds terugkijken naar het verleden. Naar wat er beter kan. En juist dit willen we niet. Dus houden wij ons vandaag de dag nog steeds aan die vraag “Wat nou, als we ons werk gaan doen zoals we het </span></span><em><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">eigenlijk</span></span></em><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> willen doen?” Want aan de basis daarvan ligt een simpel feit: van blije collega’s krijg je blije klanten. Daarom doen we er alles aan om altijd met een glimlach te kunnen werken, in onze teams en daarbuiten. Onze klanten zitten in de vitale industrieën van Nederland, in de sectoren Financial Services, Asset Management, Manufacturing, Retail, Energy, Public & </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Government</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> en Transport & </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Logistics</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">. Wij hebben kantoren in Schiphol-Rijk, Rotterdam en Eindhoven, waar wij met bijna 500 collega’s samenwerken in zelfsturende teams. Wij geloven namelijk dat je met de juiste combinatie van slimme mensen in de juiste setting en met de juiste intenties, alles kunt bereiken. We dragen daarbij als collega’s allemaal de verantwoordelijkheid om de continuïteit, groei en kwaliteit van Schuberg </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Philis</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> te bewerkstelligen. Omdat onafhankelijkheid en zelfsturing bij ons hoog in het vaandel staan, is onze organisatie 100% eigendom van alle collega’s, waardoor we ‘baas’ zijn over onze eigen toekomst en zelf de koers kunnen bepalen.</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop" data-ccp-charstyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"920dbcde-2834-5e15-a5fa-062170b236ba|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",469777841,"Aptos",469777842,"Arial",469777843,"Aptos",469777844,"Aptos",201341986,"1",469769226,"Aptos,Arial",268442635,"24",469775450,"eop",201340122,"1",134233614,"true",469778129,"eop",335572020,"1",469778324,"Default Paragraph Font"]}"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">De uitdaging </span></span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Wij hebben veel ambitie, we willen groeien, onszelf ontwikkelen en onze impact vergroten. Het soort vragen van onze klanten ontwikkelt zich, we zullen nog meer dan nu, betrokken raken bij de vragen achter de IT vraag: de strategische businessvragen van onze klanten. Digitale transformatie, software development, data </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">science</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> en business consulting zijn belangrijke pijlers binnen onze groei. We zullen ook steeds vaker met onze klanten samen experimenteren, om de nuttige inzet van nieuwe technologieën verder te versnellen. En we voelen zelf sterk de behoefte om een nog veel grotere maatschappelijke impact te creëren. We beleven dit als een mooi avontuur waarbij we onszelf steeds opnieuw moeten uitvinden. Dit zorgt ervoor dat er steeds weer nieuwe kansen zijn om als individu en als bedrijf je te blijven ontwikkelen. </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">De persoon </span></span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Om deze groei te initiëren, begeleiden en verder te versnellen zoeken we commerciële leiders die de richting van de groei gaan uitzetten. Die onze impact voor onze klanten en in </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">de</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> markt doen groeien en meebouwen aan de mooiste ICT-dienstverlener van Nederland. De rol kent veel dimensies en verantwoordelijkheden. Het is belangrijk om hierbij te melden dat deze verantwoordelijkheden samengaan met het mandaat om te kunnen handelen. Wij geloven erin dat context van de situatie en het mandaat om te handelen de sleutel zijn naar hoge klanttevredenheid. Het functieprofiel is breed en we zoeken daar een persoonlijkheid bij met de volgende kenmerken: </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Ondernemend, ambitieus</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Iemand die samen met ons Schuberg </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Philis</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> naar grote hoogten wil brengen. Je neemt geen genoegen met de status quo en zoekt altijd naar manieren om weer een stapje dichter bij de 100% te komen. Je durft te ondernemen en experimenteren, bent zelf startend, resultaatgericht en gelooft in je eigen plan. Je bent overtuigend en weet jezelf, het team, de klanten en businesspartners door complexiteit van vraagstukken heen te leiden. Je stapt vooruit waar anderen terugdeinzen. De wereld is maakbaar en dat straal jij uit. </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Visie</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Als Customer Director Sales ben je in staat om de vraag achter de IT vraag (de business vraag) van de klant te signaleren. Daarnaast kun je met toegepaste creativiteit en visie nieuwe opdrachten definiëren, waarin de waarde van onze expertise en toegepaste technologie voor onze klanten tot uiting komt. </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Inhoudelijk</span></span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Je hebt ervaring in IT, begrijpt de noodzaak en impact van digitalisering en kan op consultatieve wijze de dialoog hierover met de klant op boardniveau voeren. </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">J</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">e </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">staat open voor sales methodologie als MEDDPICC, waardoor we nog succesvoller zijn in de conversie van business kansen.</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Het</span></span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> begrijpen van, of affiniteit hebben met, corporate compliance en regelgeving van toezichthouders is hierbij een pre. description: <blockquote> <p><em>Run je eigen missie kritische onderneming binnen de regio Rotterdam-Den Haag</em></p> </blockquote> <p><strong>Wij geloven dat IT-dienstverlening anders kan. En moet. </strong><br>Bij Schuberg Philis werken we aan missie-kritische IT-omgevingen die simpelweg altijd moeten werken. Dat doen we al bijna 25 jaar voor organisaties die een groot stuk van Nederland draaiend houden: van banken en energiebedrijven tot publieke instellingen en transport & logistiek. Systemen die de ruggengraat vormen van Nederland. We leveren niet alleen technologie, maar vooral zekerheid en veranderkracht (weerbaar & wendbaar)</p> <p>En dat doen we op onze eigen manier. title: Customer Director Consulting - Insurance & Pensions
description: <blockquote>Impact op het snijvlak van business en technologie.</blockquote> <p><strong>De rol  </strong></p> <p>Bij Schuberg Philis werken we anders dan de meeste IT‑organisaties. Wij leveren mission‑critical IT met multidisciplinaire, zelfsturende teams die de volledige Plan–Build–Run verantwoordelijkheid dragen. Geen overdrachtsmomenten, geen standaard blueprints, maar experts die samen end‑to‑end verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor continuïteit, veiligheid en echte businesswaarde.</p> <p>De Customer Director Consulting Insurance & Pensions is de strategische gesprekspartner op C‑level die de brug slaat tussen boardroomstrategie en mission‑critical oplossingen die aantoonbaar waarde creëren in de verzekerings‑ en pensioensector. Je beweegt je moeiteloos in de wereld van GWP, COR, Solvency ratio, TCO en CSM, en weet deze metrics te vertalen naar concrete verbeterkansen op het snijvlak van efficiency, resilience en revenue.</p> <p>Je gaat het gesprek aan met bestuurders, directieleden en senior management bij verzekeraars en pensioenuitvoeringsorganisaties. In de vroege fases van een engagement – van eerste verkenning tot proof of value – leg jij de verbinding tussen hun strategische agenda (bijvoorbeeld DORA, AI‑adoptie, legacy‑modernisering, operationele weerbaarheid) en de proposities van Schuberg Philis op het gebied van cloud, data & AI, software en security. Je helpt hen paradoxen op te lossen: niet óf kosten omlaag óf kwaliteit omhoog, maar én efficiënter, én weerbaarder, én een beter resultaat voor klanten en deelnemers.</p> <p>Voor veel Senior Managers, Directors en ervaren Business/Technology Consultants uit de verzekerings‑ en pensioensector is dit de perfecte combinatie: inhoudelijke diepgang, strategische business‑vraagstukken, sector‑specifieke metrics en regelgeving, en echte impact op C‑level, zonder dat je fulltime commercieel of people‑manager hoeft te worden. Hier draait het om vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en het bouwen van oplossingen die er daadwerkelijk toe doen – voor klanten, hun polishouders en deelnemers, én voor Nederland. </p> <p>Je krijgt de autonomie die in grote corporates vaak ontbreekt: directe klantrelaties, korte lijnen, weinig interne lagen en de vrijheid om je eigen agenda en aanpak te bepalen. Je bent een volwaardig sparringpartner voor CIO’s, COO’s, CDO’s, CRO’s en CFRO’s in de sector, en tegelijk een meewerkend voorman/vrouw in onze klantteams: je staat met één been in de boardroom en met het andere in de praktijk van onze engineers. </p> <p><strong> </strong><strong>Jouw domein focus  </strong></p> <p>Je richt je op verzekeraars (schade, leven, zorg) en pensioenuitvoerders in Nederland – met een specifieke focus op partijen waar efficiency, AI en resilience onder zware toezicht‑ en kostendruk hoog op de agenda staan. Denk aan thema’s als:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Operationele efficiency: verlaging van TCO, verbeteren van COR, modernisering van legacy‑platformen en rationalisatie van het IT‑landschap. </p> </li> <li> <p>Resilience & compliance: DORA, AI‑Act, cyberweerbaarheid</p> </li> <li> <p>Data & AI: fact‑based besluitvorming, inzet van AI voor claims, pricing, fraudedetectie en klantinteractie, en het daadwerkelijk realiseren van business value in plaats van alleen pilot.</p> </li> <li> <p>Pensions‑transitie: administratieve en IT‑uitdagingen rondom het nieuwe pensioenstelsel, TCO‑beheersing in een complexe, gereguleerde omgeving en transparante communicatie richting deelnemers.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Je begrijpt de dynamiek van een sterk geconcentreerde markt met een paar grote spelers, complexe distributieketens (intermediair, direct, bancassurance, volmachten, pensioenuitvoeringsorganisaties) en stevige toezichtseisen. Je bent in staat om strategische keuzes van de board – rond groei, consolidatie, digitalisering en risicobeheersing – te vertalen naar roadmaps en concrete engagements waarin de proposities van Schuberg Philis direct bijdragen aan hun operationeel resultaat.</p> <p><strong>Wat je gaat doen  </strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Je voert diepgaande gesprekken met C‑level en Senior management bij verzekeraars en pensioenuitvoerders om hun strategische prioriteiten, KPI’s en pijnpunten scherp te krijgen. </p> </li> <li> <p>Je analyseert de (technische én business) context van de markt, de organisatie en hun IT‑landschap, inclusief legacy, governance, risico’s en mogelijkheden voor AI en automatisering. </p> </li> <li> <p>Je creëert inzichten in de belangrijkste behoeften van opdrachtgevers en hun polishouders/deelnemers, en vertaalt deze naar concrete businesscases en waardescenario’s (bijv. impact op COR, TCO, Solvency ratio)</p> </li> <li> <p>Je maakt de vertaalslag van boardroomstrategie naar (innovatieve) mission‑critical technologieoplossingen, in nauwe samenwerking met Customer Directors, Tech Leads, Architects en engineers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je initieert en begeleidt early‑stage engagements zoals assessments, design sprints, proof of value en verkennende data‑ en AI‑trajecten, waarbij je “show, don’t tell” toepast: geen losse slides, maar werkende demonstrators en tastbare resultaten.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je positioneert en verbindt de volledige Schuberg‑propositie – cloud, software, data & AI en security – rond de businessdoelstellingen van de klant, zodat we waarde leveren op de drie assen: efficiency, resilience én revenue.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je fungeert als trusted advisor in complexe besluitvormingsprocessen, helpt stakeholders alignment te vinden en begeleidt organisaties bij het nemen van keuzes met impact op meerdere jaren.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat jij brengt  </strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Je hebt ruime ervaring (>10 jaar) als (IT) Business/Management Consultant, strategisch adviseur of vergelijkbare rol in of rond de verzekerings‑ en/of pensioensector. Je kent de business van binnenuit: producten, ketens, distributie, regelgeving en de specifieke metrics van de sector.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je hebt aantoonbare affiniteit met cloudtechnologie, softwareontwikkeling, data & AI en security, en weet deze technologieën te positioneren als business enabler – niet als doel op zich.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je bent inhoudelijk en analytisch sterk (zowel kwantitatief als kwalitatief) en in staat om complexe vraagstukken terug te brengen tot heldere keuzes en onderbouwde businesscases voor C‑level. </p> </li> <li> <p>Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en begeleiden van early‑stage engagements (assessments, PoV’s, workshops, design sprints) en weet vanuit deze instappunten duurzame, langlopende samenwerkingen op te bouwen.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je hebt een sterk netwerk in de verzekerings‑ en/of pensioensector (bijvoorbeeld bij zorgverzekeraars, schade‑ en levensverzekeraars, pensioenuitvoerders en relevante brancheorganisaties) en voelt je thuis in boardrooms, toezichthoudende gremia en strategische overleggen.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je hebt ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op CxO‑ en Senior managementniveau en kunt verschillende belangen, risico‑inschattingen en perspectieven bij elkaar brengen.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je bent zelfstartend, ondernemend en enthousiasmerend. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega’s en klanten op en weet momentum te creëren – ook als er nog geen uitgekristalliseerd vraagstuk of project is.</p> </li> <li> <p>Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal op hoog niveau, in woord en geschrift, en voelt je comfortabel in formele boardpresentaties én informele strategiegesprekken.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Als jij energie krijgt van gesprekken op C‑level, het verbinden van sectorstrategie met mission‑critical technologie, het versnellen van innovatie en het bouwen aan duurzame waarde in een sterk gereguleerde, kritische sector, dan spreken we je graag. Je helpt verzekeraars en pensioenuitvoerders om zonder compromis waarde te creëren op efficiency, resilience én revenue – precies daar waar het er het meest toe doet.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. title: Cloud Engineer - AWS
description: <blockquote>Enable teams and customers with secure, reliable cloud foundations</blockquote> <p class="p1">At Schuberg Philis, we believe in purposeful responsibility. Every customer has a dedicated team of engineers who take end-to-end responsibility for their mission-critical platforms and applications. For one of our dedicated customer teams, we are looking for a Cloud Engineer AWS to design, build, and maintain the backbone of our services: the AWS landing zone.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>Your Role</strong></p> <p class="p1">As a Cloud Engineer AWS, you are responsible for the cloud infrastructure that powers the tools and services for our clients. You will manage the entire lifecycle of one or more landing zones—both our in-house platforms and client-specific environments—ensuring they are secure, scalable, and highly available. Your focus will be on modern cloud-native technologies, using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation to drive efficiency and reliability.</p> <p class="p1">You will be a key enabler for your team members, providing them with a stable and advanced platform so they can focus on delivering value to the client. This is a hands-on role where you will not only maintain the current environment but also actively shape its future by implementing new services and adopting the latest AWS innovations.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1"><strong>How you add value</strong></p> <ul> <li class="p1">Design, build, and manage AWS landing zones using modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles, with a strong focus on AWS CDK and CloudFormation.</li> <li class="p1">Manage and operate containerized applications and services using AWS Fargate and other AWS container services (e.g., EKS), ensuring robust and scalable deployments.</li> <li class="p1">Automate operational tasks, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure management using scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.</li> <li class="p1">Ensure the stability and performance of the platform through proactive monitoring, logging, and incident management.</li> <li class="p1">Manage the full lifecycle of the Linux-based environments, from provisioning and configuration to maintenance and decommissioning.</li> <li class="p1">Act as a technical advisor within the team, guiding colleagues on cloud best practices, security, and architectural decisions.</li> <li class="p1">Collaborate in a Git-driven workflow, using tools like GitLab and GitHub.</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>How you make the difference</strong></p> <p class="p1">You are passionate about automation and automation and building resilient, mission-critical systems. You are not simply following best practices—you set them. Taking ownership, you make the platform invisible, so your team can be visible in their impact</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What you bring</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Proven track record as a System Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or DevOps Engineer<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>in a complex, mission-critical AWS environment.</li> <li class="li1">Strong, hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly with AWS CDK and/or CloudFormation.</li> <li class="li1">Proven experience with AWS container services, with a strong focus on AWS Fargate.</li> <li class="li1">Deep knowledge of Linux system administration.</li> <li class="li1">Proficiency in one or more scripting languages: Python, Bash, or PowerShell.</li> <li class="li1">Solid understanding of CI/CD principles, configuration management, and monitoring concepts.</li> <li class="li1">Familiarity with tools like Datadog, Splunk, Okta, GitLab or GitHub is a plus.</li> <li class="li1">Legacy tool experience such as Chef or Octopus is appreciated, but not a must.</li> </ul> <p class="p1">Ready to take 100% responsibility, together? We look forward to hearing from you.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. </em><br><em> </em><br><em>It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Chief of Staff
description: Location: Amsterdam (NL) At Plumerai, we make it easy and affordable for developers to add highly accurate AI to their camera devices, enabling them to create amazing new products. Our AI is helping millions of people feel safe and making their lives more convenient. Major brands deploy our advanced computer vision AI on millions of smart home cameras in the field and we’re rapidly expanding into commercial security, retail, assisted living, and more. The recent improvements in multimodal LLMs are unlocking valuable new applications in these markets with Plumerai as the driving force. We combine our on-device Tiny AI software with our cloud-based Vision Language Models, providing People Detection, Video Search, AI Captions, Familiar Face Identification, Multi-camera ReID, Real-time Alerts and more. The best solution runs as much as possible on-device to enable low-power, accurate, and private AI products. This is where Plumerai leads, even outperforming Google Nest on accuracy. We are now starting to invest heavily in market adoption. We build the most accurate and efficient AI solutions by vertically integrating all layers of the stack. From data collection and curation, custom training software, model architectures, multimodal LLMs, pre- and postprocessing, and all the way down to the fastest inference engines. Not only does our team have a deep theoretical understanding of all these components, we also know how to ship fast and often. Our team is based in London and Amsterdam, we have recently raised funding to provide multiple years of runway, while our recurring revenue is growing rapidly. We are backed by world-class investors such as Tony Fadell (creator of iPod, iPhone; founder of Nest), Hermann Hauser (founder of Arm), Zoubin Ghahramani (Google DeepMind), and others. See https://techcrunch.com/2024/10/06/tony-fadell-backed-plumerai-brings-on-device-ai-to-home-security-cameras/ and https://blog.plumerai.com/2025/09/plumerai-raises-usd8-7m-series-a/ 🎥 Get to know Plumerai: ▶️ Life at Plumerai ▶️ What we're building About the role We are looking for a Chief of Staff who will help us accelerate our growth by tackling whatever limiting factor we face. You will become a direct extension of the CEO and will work very closely with him. You will drive two to four high-priority strategic initiatives that the CEO cannot personally execute. Your work will range from taking ownership of everything required to make a product launch successful and temporarily leading functions until a specialist is hired to optimizing our recruitment process and preparing for a new fundraising process. You’re someone who thrives on complex problem-solving with a lot of unknowns, can absorb a lot of information quickly, and is used to context switching. You are comfortable taking on work you have never done before. You will discuss strategy with the CEO and be in the room for the company’s most important conversations. You understand that shipping fast today is often more important than waiting for a fully refined product in two months. Every week will be different. As we enter our most ambitious stage, we’re looking for someone who can do whatever is needed to help us move faster. The Chief of Staff is one of the highest-impact roles in the company. What you will be doing Work directly with our CEO on whatever matters most. Shape the strategy for new product launches, handle the operations or coordinate PR outreach. Help scale our recruitment process, co-own executive recruiting, organize recruitment events, think about our employer brand, and join candidate interviews. Implement AI agents in the operations of our company. Write external and internal communications, explaining complex ideas simply. Investigate new potential markets and clearly formulate what ‘Plumerai for X’ would look like. Support the CEO with investor relations and fundraising processes. Preparing board packs, data rooms, and investor materials. Find answers to legal or regulatory questions that affect our business. Stay close to the product roadmap, ensuring decisions are grounded in business strategy. What we are looking for You get things done and have a lot of energy. No job is beneath you and you do whatever it takes. You don't wait for permission. You always have a clear understanding of what needs to be prioritized, and you help the people around you stay focused on the right things. You’re a generalist who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists. You’re analytical and have excellent attention to detail. You’re comfortable with technology, including AI tools, and can learn new tools quickly. You’re fluent in English. You will typically have around 5-8 years of experience in a high-performance environment, such as consulting, investment banking, VC, or a fast-scaling startup. What we offer Competitive salary. Visa sponsorship. Generous equity stake in the company. Relocation assistance. Choose your own laptop. 25 days of paid vacation in addition to public holidays. We only consider applicants who are currently based in, or willing to relocate to, the Amsterdam region. We have flexible working hours. As you will work very closely with the CEO, you are expected to work from our office in central Amsterdam on most working days. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Experience with Deep Reinforcement Learning. We only consider applicants who are currently based in, or willing to relocate to, London or Amsterdam. We have flexible working hours and work together from our offices on at least 2 fixed days per week. What we offer Competitive salary. Generous equity stake in the company. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Storage Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | Austin, US; Seattle, US or London, UK</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) builds and launches new products on Cloudflare’s global network. Within ETI, you’ll join the Storage Infrastructure team to build and operate a shared storage platform for the teams behind stateful products such as R2, Workers KV, and Durable Objects.</p> <p>We manage the underlying storage hardware, distributed databases, and object storage clusters, including fleet lifecycle automation, capacity, hardware validation, failure-domain planning, observability, and production operations. In this role, you will build platform software and automation that makes these fleet operations safe, repeatable, and scalable.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design and build automation and operator tooling for provisioning, configuring, expanding, upgrading, and decommissioning storage hardware, distributed databases, and object storage clusters.</li> <li>Engineer globally distributed storage fleets to tolerate hardware failures, network disruption, capacity pressure, and recovery events across multiple failure domains.</li> <li>Develop observability, alerting, and safety controls that help engineers understand fleet health and make auditable production changes.</li> <li>Diagnose incidents across Linux, storage, networking, and distributed systems; participate in on-call and implement durable fixes that reduce operational toil.</li> <li>Use AI tools throughout development and operations to accelerate debugging, incident triage, root-cause analysis, and toil reduction, while applying sound engineering judgment and verifying outputs before taking production action.</li> <li>Validate new storage hardware and characterize its performance during normal operation, failures, rebuilds, and other recovery conditions.</li> <li>Partner with R2, Workers KV, Durable Objects, Network, Capacity Planning, Performance Engineering, and Infrastructure Operations to turn service requirements into infrastructure capabilities.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure platforms or large-scale production fleets, including automation of lifecycle operations.</li> <li>Strong Linux systems knowledge and experience troubleshooting across compute, storage, and networking layers.</li> <li>Experience operating distributed systems in production, including observability, incident response, reliability improvements, and safe change management.</li> <li>Ability to write maintainable software in at least one programming language, such as Go, Rust, or Python.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams and technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience operating distributed databases or object storage systems, with knowledge of storage fundamentals such as filesystems, SSD behavior, replication, and rebuild dynamics.</li> <li>Experience with bare-metal provisioning, hardware lifecycle management, or storage hardware validation.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code, configuration-management, or observability systems such as Terraform, SaltStack, Prometheus, or Grafana.</li> <li>Experience with capacity modeling, workload placement, failure-domain planning, or cross-datacenter networking.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Director of rewards, data & analytics
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? As Director, Rewards & Data, you make pay, equity, benefits, workforce costs and People data work as one decision system You join the People Leadership Team and lead a team of three experts (Compensation; People Data & HR Cockpit; Cost Control & Workforce Planning), plus our Benefits and Immigration providers. Your mandate has two sides: Total Rewards — design and run a reward system (compensation, stock options and BSPCE, benefits, international mobility) that is competitive, fair, transparent and financially sustainable. People data and workforce economics — give leadership a reliable, shared view of headcount, people costs and workforce trends, and turn it into recommendations before decisions are made. What you'll do Build and lead the hub Set the hub's vision, roadmap and ways of working; lead and grow your three experts and manage specialist providers with clear accountability. Define who decides what with People Partners, Finance, Legal, Payroll and People Operations & Tech, and shape our People strategy as a member of the People Leadership Team. Own Total Rewards and compensation Own our reward philosophy and global compensation framework: job architecture, salary ranges, benchmarking and pay positioning. Lead the annual compensation review with Finance, and advise executives and People Partners on offers, promotions, retention and organisational changes. Monitor internal equity and market competitiveness, and get Back Market ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Steer our equity programmes (stock options and BSPCE) Own equity principles, governance and the role of equity in total compensation, with Finance and Legal. Guarantee a reliable, documented and auditable lifecycle from grant to exit, and help employees understand and value their equity. Turn People data into decisions Own the HR Cockpit priorities and the definition of our key People metrics, built on Workday and aligned with company data standards. Co-steer workforce planning and the people cost trajectory with Finance (headcount, compensation, equity, benefits, contingent workers), with scenarios for organisational decisions. Shape benefits and international mobility Set the principles for global and local benefits and immigration, and manage providers on compliance, quality, cost and employee experience as we grow internationally. Keep it trustworthy Make sure reward decisions and sensitive data are handled with clear governance, approvals, auditability and data protection, and flag reward-related risks early. What you'll bring Significant experience leading a Total Rewards or Comp & Ben function in an international, multi-site company. Scale-up, tech or marketplace experience is a strong plus. Hands-on ownership of stock option and BSPCE programmes (or comparable French equity plans): governance, allocation and lifecycle. A track record of running people cost and headcount planning with Finance, and of building or rebuilding an HR data or analytics capability. Multi-country practice across Europe and at least one of the US or APAC, with working knowledge of pay transparency and pay equity requirements. Credibility with a CEO, a CFO and an Executive Committee: you bring fact-based recommendations and challenge constructively. Sound judgement balancing fairness, business needs, market competitiveness and financial sustainability. A builder mindset: you enjoy shaping a hub that is still taking form with a lean team, and you stay close enough to the detail to guarantee quality. The ability to explain complex reward and equity topics simply, and to handle sensitive matters with discretion. Fluent English (our working language). WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training. At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values. We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications. If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

defects.</p></li><li><p><strong>Maintain Program Visibility:</strong> Track hardware build cycles in Jira, leading documentation, status check-ins, and project closeouts alongside cross-functional description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team. To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. title: Engineering Manager, Browser Run
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon</strong></span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Department</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Team</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We build the tooling and platform capabilities that power the next generation of AI agents on the Cloudflare Developer Platform. Our goal is to make it easier for agents to interact with the web, and to be observed and controlled while they do it — without giving up performance, scalability or security.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the centre of that work, and it is the product this role owns. It runs full browser sessions on Cloudflare’s global network and lets developers drive them with code or with an agent: a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint that any Puppeteer, Playwright or CDP client can connect to from anywhere, Workers bindings, and a REST API for the common jobs — screenshots, PDFs, Markdown extraction, scraping and crawling. On top of that sit session recording and replay, live debugging, and a path for a human to step in when an agent gets stuck.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">It is used by external developers building agents, crawlers and scrapers, and by other Cloudflare teams who need a browser they can trust. It is also a billed product on a steep growth curve, which makes capacity, cold-start latency, concurrency limits and abuse protection product problems rather than merely operational ones.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The team’s wider portfolio includes an agent-first browser built on Workers rather than containers, a managed CI platform for the agent development lifecycle, visual regression testing delivered as a service, a pre-rendering service, URL Scanner, and CDNJS. Browser Run is the focus of this role today; there is scope for more of that portfolio to come into it as the role and the team grow.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run went from an internal rendering tool to a public, billed product, and the surface has not stopped moving — the CDP endpoint, MCP client support, session replay and the REST API all landed inside a year. That pace is the point, and it is the thing this role has to make sustainable.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are a tight-knit team that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to the highest standard.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Role</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a hands-on engineering management role. You will own Browser Run engineering end to end — the people, the roadmap, the reliability, and the story we tell customers about it. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager for AI Agents Tooling & Platform and partner closely with Product Management, Developer Relations, and platform teams across Cloudflare.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the primary focus. The team owns other products, and there is scope for some of them to move into your remit as the role and the team grow, but we are hiring someone to make Browser Run excellent first.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will not be writing most of the code. You will be expected to understand it well enough to review a design document, challenge an architecture, and know when an estimate is wrong.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What you’ll do</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Manage, coach and grow the team of systems engineers behind Browser Run — 1:1s, career development, performance conversations, and hiring.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the Browser Run roadmap and delivery, and give the team and the wider organisation clear visibility into what is being worked on, in what order, and what we are deliberately not doing.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Partner with Product Management to set direction: shape the roadmap, pressure-test scope, and make the trade-off calls that keep an incubation product shipping.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own Browser Run’s operational health — browser fleet capacity, session reliability, cold-start latency, concurrency limits, on-call rotations, alert quality and incident follow-through. External developers and other Cloudflare teams depend on this service.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Keep the automation surface honest: Puppeteer and Playwright compatibility, CDP behaviour that matches what developers expect from a local Chrome, and a credible story for Chrome version upgrades.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop leaders. Identify and grow the engineers who will run day-to-day delivery for an area of the product, and hand that work to them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Resolve cross-team dependencies with the Workers, Developer Platform, Security and Billing teams, and bring contentious technical decisions to closure quickly and calmly.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the commercial mechanics of a billed service, including the unglamorous parts: usage metering, quotas, plan limits, abuse protection and pricing input.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Represent Browser Run externally through launch blog posts, developer documentation, conference talks and direct customer conversations.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About you</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You have run an engineering team that shipped, and you can point at what it shipped.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You give your technical legos away. Your measure of success is the team’s output and the growth of the people on it, not your own commit history.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You are comfortable with ambiguity. Incubation means the requirements move, and you can change direction without drama.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You are direct. You give feedback early, disagree openly, and admit when you were wrong.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You write well. You believe a clear design document, roadmap or incident report is as much of a deliverable as the code.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You care about operational quality and treat a noisy alert as a bug, not as background noise.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You find browsers genuinely interesting as an engineering problem — how Chrome behaves under load, why automation breaks, and what an AI agent actually needs from a browser it does not own.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You want to join a team that upholds a culture of support, open and honest communication, and collaborative problem-solving.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">2+ years managing engineering teams, on top of a solid track record as a hands-on engineer.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience owning a production service end to end, including on-call rotation, capacity planning and incident review.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Demonstrated experience growing engineers — promotions you supported, and ideally a team lead or first-line manager you developed.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Hands-on familiarity with browser automation — Chrome DevTools Protocol, Puppeteer or Playwright — or with the browser internals underneath them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, web platform fundamentals (HTTP, JavaScript execution models, rendering) or cloud infrastructure — enough to hold a credible design review.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><
